jobs.title: Dynamics 365 CE Engineer
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen

Note: good command of the Dutch language in word and writing is a requirement-

UWV zet Dynamics 365 CE in voor kritische processen rondom werk en inkomen. Als Dynamics CE Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, configureren, implementeren en onderhouden van onze Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) omgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars, testers en business stakeholders om onze CRM-oplossingen te verbeteren en uit te breiden. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het vertalen van functionele wensen naar technische oplossingen en zorgt voor een stabiele, schaalbare en gebruiksvriendelijke omgeving.

Dit ga je doen:

Ontwerpen en configureren van Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen, waaronder entiteiten, workflows, business rules, en Power Automate flows.
Customizen en uitbreiden van de Dynamics CE omgeving met behulp van JavaScript, TypeScript, en .NET (C#).
Integreren van Dynamics CE met andere systemen (bijv. Azure, SharePoint, Power Platform, en legacy systemen) via APIs, Azure Logic Apps, en Azure Service Bus.
Optimaliseren van prestaties, beveiliging en gebruikerservaring binnen de Dynamics CE omgeving.
Onderhouden en updaten van de omgeving, inclusief patch management en upgrades.
Samenwerken met DevOps-teams om CI/CD-pijplijnen te verbeteren en automatisering te bevorderen.
Adviseren over best practices en nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen het Dynamics 365 ecosysteem.
Ondersteunen bij het oplossen van complexe technische issues en incidenten.

Wat we van je verwachten

Binnen UWV wordt gewerkt op basis van ‘vertrouwen in vakmanschap’. Dit betekent dat wij op zoek zijn naar IT talent dat zich bewust is van de eigen kwaliteiten en nieuwsgierig is om zichzelf verder te ontwikkelen. Verder neem je mee:

Essentieel:

Diepgaande kennis van Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), inclusief:
Customization (entiteiten, velden, formulieren, weergaven, dashboards)
Business Process Flows, Workflows, en Business Rules
Plugins, Custom Workflow Activities, en Web Resources (JavaScript/TypeScript)
Power Automate (Flows) en Power Apps
Datamodel en relaties, inclusief 1:N, N:1, en N:N relaties
Beveiligingsmodellen (Security Roles, Field Level Security, Hierarchy Security)
Ervaring met ontwikkelen in:
C# (.NET Framework/.NET Core) voor plugins en custom workflows
JavaScript/TypeScript voor client-side scripting en Web API integraties
RESTful APIs en OData endpoints
Kennis van Azure-diensten zoals:
Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus
Azure DevOps (repositories, pipelines, releases)
Azure Key Vault, Application Insights
Ervaring met datamigratie en ETL-processen (bijv. met KingswaySoft, Scribe, of SSIS)
Kennis van Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents)
Ervaring met ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) en CI/CD voor Dynamics 365
Kennis van SQL Server en het schrijven van complexe queries voor rapportage en data-analyse
Ervaring met integraties tussen Dynamics CE en andere systemen (bijv. SharePoint, Office 365, legacy systemen)

Pre:

Ervaring met Dynamics 365 Field Service of Customer Service modules
Kennis van Portals (Power Pages) en/of Dynamics 365 Marketing
Ervaring met Azure Synapse Analytics of Dataverse
Kennis van F# of andere functionele programmeertalen
Certificeringen zoals MB-210, MB-240, MB-400, PL-200, PL-400

Persoonlijke competenties

Analytisch sterk en probleemoplossend vermogen
Communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
Teamplayer met een proactieve houding
Klantgericht en resultaatgedreven
Nederlands en Engels vloeiend in woord en geschrift

Wat kun je van ons verwachten

Wij vragen nogal wat, en bieden daarvoor veel terug. Je komt in een complexe agile werkomgeving terecht, waar initiatief nemen en samenwerken hoog in het vaandel staan. De functie is afwisselend en veelzijdig. We bieden je de kans aan om een directe en wezenlijk bijdrage te leveren aan de ontwikkeling van uitstekende digitale dienstverlening voor alle burgers en werkgevers van Nederland.

Werken bij UWV betekent een goede werk-privé balans en aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden. Verder kun je het volgende van ons verwachten:

Een inschaling in tot maximaal circa € 96,5K all-in totaal per jaar voor een senior kandidaat, dat is:
Inclusief een 13e maand.
Inclusief 8% vakantiegeld.
Een goede pensioenvoorziening.
Hybride werken.
Een laptop, smartphone en andere voorzieningen om thuis goed te werken.
Een werkplek die goed te bereiken is met ov.
Bij voorkeur een werkweek van 32 tot 38 uur per week.

Iets meer over ons

UWV is hét uitvoeringsinstituut voor werknemersverzekeringen en arbeidsmarktinformatie in Nederland. We zetten ons in voor werkzoekenden, werkgevers en werknemers, en spelen een cruciale rol in de digitale transformatie van de arbeidsmarkt. Onze IT-afdeling werkt continu aan innovatieve oplossingen om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren. Binnen ons Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) team zoeken we een ervaren Dynamics CE Engineer die onze klantgerichte processen verder digitaliseert en optimaliseert.

Iets voor jou?

Wij verzoeken je uitsluitend via de sollicitatielink te solliciteren.

jobs.title: Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop software for high-tech products and machines.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high-tech solutions to life.

What excites you as a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA?

As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Apeldoorn or at our clients’ premises, you enjoy working on:

Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high-quality results.

Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C#, C++, or Java.
You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

Important note:

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the US Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
What is your role?

At Lely, software is at the heart of the next generation of autonomous farming. Our robots, edge devices and cloud platforms work together to help dairy farmers operate more efficiently and sustainably.

As a Software Architect, you shape the technical direction of this ecosystem. You work closely with software engineers, product teams and other technical disciplines to design scalable solutions while helping teams continuously improve the way they build software. This is a hands-on architecture role where technical leadership, collaboration and software craftsmanship go hand in hand.

You are responsible for guiding architectural decisions across multiple domains while remaining closely connected to implementation. Whether you are defining architectural direction, supporting teams in making technical trade-offs, or contributing to critical parts of the solution yourself, your work directly influences the quality, scalability, and maintainability of our products.

Your Main Responsibilities Include

Defining and evolving end-to-end software architectures across frontend, backend, integrations, and platform domains.
Supporting development teams in making architectural decisions and balancing business needs, technical quality, and long-term maintainability.
Contributing hands-on to solution design, prototyping, and critical implementations where your expertise adds the most value.
Driving continuous improvements in areas such as scalability, modularity, technical debt reduction, and software quality.
Coaching and mentoring engineers, helping teams strengthen their technical craftsmanship and architectural thinking.
Collaborating closely with Product Management, UX, Data, and Platform teams to deliver solutions that create value for our customers.
Explore how AI-powered engineering can improve software development and help teams adopt these technologies in a practical way.

Apply now

What is your experience?

You are an experienced software professional who enjoys working at both strategic and technical levels. You know how to create alignment across teams, can communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and enjoy helping others grow.

In Addition, You Bring

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Extensive experience as a Software Architect, Lead Engineer, or Senior Software Engineer with architectural responsibilities.
A broad understanding of modern software development across multiple domains, such as frontend applications, backend services, APIs, cloud platforms, and DevOps practices.
Experience designing scalable and maintainable software architectures in complex environments.
The ability to balance innovation, technical constraints, and business priorities.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills within multidisciplinary Agile environments.
Experience with technologies such as .NET, distributed systems, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and modern frontend frameworks is highly valuable.

What you can expect from us

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.
A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
A Salary range of €6600 - €9400 gross per month, with clear opportunities for growth within the scale.
Full ownership of your own development, with access to a wide range of courses through the Lely Academy.
Daily access to outstanding sports facilities at the Lely Campus: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.

Work-life balance

A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00).
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
And of course: we love to celebrate! Whether it’s an anniversary or the annual Christmas party. At Lely, we know how to do it.

We are also proud that our vision and efforts have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneurs Award 2025.

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or staffing agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we recruit all our candidates directly. We understand that as intermediaries, you want to present candidates for our great positions and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

About Lely

Founded in 1948, Lely is committed to a sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future in agriculture. Driven by the challenges faced by farmers and the needs of cows, we develop high-quality robots and data systems that improve animal welfare, flexibility, and productivity on dairy farms. Our mission is to support sustainable food production.

For more than 30 years, we have been a global leader in the sale and service of automated systems for successive generations of dairy farmers. Every day, we inspire our colleagues to offer customers innovative solutions and to be a reliable partner for long-term advice and support. With our state-of-the-art Lely Campus in Maassluis and a global network of dedicated Lely Centers offering customized sales and service, Lely is active in more than fifty countries.

Ozan Arikan

jobs.title: Junior Research Software Engineer for Sustainability Science - Full Stack- NL
jobs.description:
The Institute of Environmental Science CML at Leiden University is looking for a motivated Junior Research Software Engineer (RSE) with experience in full-stack development, data visualization, and modern software engineering practices to turn scientific insights into reliable and user-friendly software. In this role, you will help design, build, and maintain the next generation of industrial ecology research tools that support sustainability, circular economy analysis and decision making, as well as reproducible science across the institute. You will work closely with researchers to help create dashboards, APIs, and visual analytics that communicate scientific results to academic users, policymakers, and the wider public. Your contributions will directly empower transparent, open, and reproducible research within for sustainability decision making.

What You Will Do

In your role, you will work closely with a Senior Research Software Engineers, Principal Investigators and PhDs to strengthen the scientific software engineering basis of our institute. Specifically, you will be responsible for tasks such as:

Building and maintaining scientific software, web applications and dashboards for research dissemination and policy communication (e.g., WISE database, Activity Browser, Panorama web-app, ReLab)
Supporting the development and maintenance of data pipelines and reproducible workflows for environmental databases and analytics.
Collaborating with researchers to scope features, translate research needs into user-friendly tools, and ensure usability and accessibility.
Supporting deployment in cloud and/or open environments (e.g., containerized services), working with the senior RSE on infrastructure alignment.
Promoting good data and software management for FAIR and open science practices, version control (Git/GitHub), testing (pytest), packaging, documentation, etc.

Where you will work

Leiden University is situated between Amsterdam (36 km) and The Hague (15 km) and was founded in 1575, making it the oldest university in the Netherlands. It houses around 35,000 students originating from 112 nationalities, facilitated by approximately 8,000 staff.

The Institute of Environmental Science (CML) at Leiden University offers a vibrant and supportive community of scientists committed to the challenges of sustainability. CML distinguishes itself for its attention to professional development in coordination with the interests of its scientists. As such, there are plenty of opportunities to learn new skills, expand your knowledge, collaborate across disciplines, and experiment in a friendly environment fully embodying academic freedom across all career levels.

The core focus of CML is to perform research and education in the interdisciplinary field of Environmental Sciences. CML focuses on the sustainable use of natural resources and preservation of natural capital and biodiversity. CML has a culture of mutual support and collaboration between researchers. CML has two Departments: Industrial Ecology (CML-IE) and Environmental Biology (CML-EB). Presently, about 150 fte (including postdocs and PhDs) are employed at CML. CML further collaborates with TU Delft and Erasmus University in the Leiden-Delft-Erasmus Centre for Sustainability (LDE-CfS), and with the Naturalis Biodiversity Centre.

The Institute of Environmental Sciences (CML) is positioned in the Faculty of Sciences. The Faculty of Science is a world-class faculty where staff and students work together in a dynamic international environment. It is a faculty where personal and academic development are top priorities. Our people are committed to expanding fundamental knowledge by curiosity and looking beyond the borders of their own discipline; their aim is to benefit science and to make a contribution to addressing the major societal challenges of the future. The research carried out at the Faculty of Science is very diverse, ranging from mathematics, information science, astronomy, physics, chemistry and bio-pharmaceutical sciences to biology and environmental sciences. The research activities are organized in eight institutes. These institutes offer eight bachelor’s and twelve master’s programmes. The faculty has grown strongly in recent years and now has more than 2.800 staff and almost 6000 students. We are located at the heart of Leiden’s Bio Science Park, one of Europe’s biggest science parks, where university and business life come together.

For more information, see www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/science. Information about CML can be found at www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/science/environmental-sciences.

What You Bring

MSc in computer science, data science, AI, environmental informatics, or related field.
Good programming skills with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. Other programming languages are a plus.
Experience with front‑end frameworks (e.g., React) and data visualization (e.g., D3/Plotly).
Experience building back‑end APIs (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask) and integrating databases (SQL/NoSQL).
Experience contributing to open‑source projects.
Familiarity with containerization (e.g., Docker) and reproducibility tools
Excellent collaboration skills, a service mindset, and enthusiasm for environmental applications and open science

What We Offer

We offer an initial one-year contract, with an option to extend to a permanent contract based on performance, following the pay scale 9 in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch Universities. Salary ranges from € 3.708 to € 5.057 gross per month based on a full-time position .

At our institution, we believe in flexibility and work-life balance! With a full-time position (38 hours per week), you are entitled to 232 vacation hours per year
, which is equivalent to 30.5 vacation days
(based on a 38-hour work week). If you value flexibility, you have the freedom to adjust your working hours. For example, you could choose to work 40 hours per week, earning extra compensation hours. Alternatively, if you prefer a shorter work week, you can work 36 hours per week by using some of your vacation days to create more time for yourself. You’ll work closely with your supervisor to tailor your schedule in a way that suits both your needs and the team’s.

In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

Holiday allowance (8%) and an end-of-year bonus (8.3%)
An attractive pension scheme with ABP, ensuring your financial well-being both now and in the future
Extensive options for secondary employment conditions: You can explore options such as sabbaticals, paid parental leave, and the individual choices model, which allows you to exchange leave days and/or salary for benefits like an advantageous sports subscription, bicycle scheme, and childcare options
Hybrid working options: If your role allows, you can enjoy the flexibility of working from home within the Netherlands
Home-working allowance: You’ll receive a home-working allowance (for both workdays and internet), and the university will provide you with a laptop and support for creating a comfortable home office

We are committed to offering a flexible, supportive, and rewarding work environment, designed to help you grow both professionally and personally. For more information about the working conditions, please visit: https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/working-at/job-application-procedure-and-employment-conditions

What We Value

At the Faculty of Science, we value inclusiveness and strive for a diverse community with equal opportunities for all. We give full support to our staff in achieving their potential to become independent academic researchers and teachers. For more information about our policy on diversity and equality please go to the diversity page on our website: https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/dossiers/diversity

Female researchers are also welcome to join the Researchers In Science for Equality network of the Faculty of Science (rise.nu).

Want to apply or find out more?

Enquiries can be made to sollicitaties@cml.leidenuniv.nl

Franco Donati
Rutger Hoekstra
Heather Logan

Senior Backend Engineer C#/.Net (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

jobs.title: Windows / Desktop Software Engineer (m/w/d) - Legal AI Automation
jobs.description:
NotarNow zählt zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Scale-ups Deutschlands – vollständig bootstrapped und ohne Venture Capital. Unser Legal AI Workspace wird bereits von über 1.500 Juristinnen und Juristen sowie mehr als 6.000 Mitarbeitenden täglich genutzt – darunter viele der renommiertesten Notariate und Kanzleien Deutschlands.

In zweieinhalb Jahren sind wir von 2 auf 15 Teammitglieder gewachsen und haben über 3 Mio. Euro ARR. Jetzt skalieren wir in Richtung 6–8 Mio. Euro ARR innerhalb der nächsten 12 Monate und bauen unser Produktportfolio weiter aus.

Du arbeitest remote oder in unserem neu gebauten Büro in der Mozartstraße 4 direkt an der Theresienwiese in München – mit neuestem Equipment, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und der Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit NotarNow zu wachsen.

Deine Rolle

Unsere Produkte laufen vollständig in der Cloud – mit einem Next.js-/TypeScript-Frontend und einem FastAPI-Backend auf AWS. Unsere Kunden arbeiten gleichzeitig mit lokalen Windows-Anwendungen, Kanzleisoftware, Druckern, Ordnerstrukturen und Schnittstellen, die nie für moderne Cloud-Software gebaut wurden.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Als Windows / Desktop Software Engineer (m/w/d)
baust Du die technische Brücke zwischen unserer Cloud und der lokalen Windows-Umgebung unserer Kunden. Unser heutiger Desktop-Client besteht aus rund 45.000 Zeilen AutoHotkey und läuft produktiv bei unseren Kunden. Jetzt entwickeln wir ihn zu einer modularen, skalierbaren und langfristig wartbaren Windows-Plattform weiter. Welche Architektur und Technologien dafür langfristig die richtigen sind, gestaltest Du maßgeblich mit.

Was Du konkret tust

Du verantwortest KI:RSTEN Desktop technisch end-to-end – Architektur, Entwicklung, Tests, Releases und produktiven Betrieb.
Du modernisierst unsere bestehende AutoHotkey-Anwendung schrittweise, ohne den laufenden Betrieb unserer Kunden zu gefährden.
Du baust und betreibst Integrationen zu mehr als zehn lokalen Kanzlei- und Notariatsprogrammen und synchronisierst Kontakte, Dokumente und Vorgangsdaten zwischen Cloud, Browser, Desktop und On-Premise-Systemen.
Du integrierst REST-/HTTP-APIs, lokale APIs, Dateisysteme, Netzlaufwerke und Importverzeichnisse und entwickelst robuste Mechanismen für Authentifizierung, Fehlerbehandlung, Retries, Timeouts und Synchronisation.
Du entwickelst lokale Services und Background-Prozesse und sorgst dafür, dass Datei- und Dokumentenverarbeitung auch bei parallelen Zugriffen, Fehlern und Wiederanläufen zuverlässig funktioniert.
Du entwickelst UI- und Prozessautomatisierungen weiter – und erkennst, wann aus einer schnellen Automatisierung eine native, langfristig wartbare Integration werden sollte.
Du baust professionelle Installer und Deployment-Prozesse inklusive Updates, Code Signing, Upgrade-Pfaden, Deinstallation und Rollback.
Du stellst durch Logging, Tests, automatisierte Builds und reproduzierbare Releases sicher, dass unsere Software auch auf unterschiedlich konfigurierten Windows-Systemen zuverlässig läuft.
Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden, Schnittstellenpartnern und externen Entwicklerteams zusammen und begleitest neue Integrationen von der technischen Abstimmung bis zum produktiven Rollout.

Mit wem Du arbeitest

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklerteam und insbesondere mit Moritz zusammen. Er ist Notar-Fachreferent und Softwareentwickler und kennt die Prozesse, Kanzleisoftwares und lokalen Integrationen unserer Kunden im Detail. Du bringst die tiefe Windows-/Desktop-Engineering-Erfahrung mit; gemeinsam entwickelt Ihr aus bestehenden Automatisierungen und Integrationen eine professionelle Plattform.

Dabei arbeitest Du regelmäßig direkt mit Kunden, der Bundesnotarkammer und Entwicklern führender On-Premise-Softwareanbieter. Mal spezifiziert Ihr gemeinsam eine API, mal analysierst Du eine historisch gewachsene lokale Schnittstelle oder einen Prozess, der auf einem Kundenrechner anders läuft als erwartet.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn Du

mehrjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Windows- oder Desktop-Entwicklung hast und Software vom Code bis zum produktiven Betrieb verantworten kannst.
Erfahrung mit C#/.NET und WPF, WinUI oder vergleichbaren Technologien mitbringst. Unser Client ist heute AutoHotkey – wohin sich die Plattform technologisch entwickelt, entscheidest Du mit.
bereits gewachsene Anwendungen schrittweise modernisiert hast, statt nur auf der grünen Wiese zu entwickeln.
sicher mit REST/HTTP, Authentifizierung, OAuth, Zertifikaten und der Kommunikation zwischen lokalen Clients und Cloud-Systemen umgehen kannst.
Windows Services, Background-Prozesse und das Windows-Berechtigungsmodell verstehst – etwa Benutzerrechte, UAC, NTFS-/Freigaberechte sowie AppData und ProgramData.
Erfahrung mit Windows-Installern, Updates, Code Signing, Upgrade-Pfaden und Rollbacks hast.
Dich gerne tief in fremde Systeme, schlecht dokumentierte Schnittstellen und ungewöhnliche technische Umgebungen einarbeitest.
technische Probleme eigenständig bis zu einer stabilen produktiven Lösung treibst und auch direkt mit Kunden und Partnern kommunizieren kannst.
sehr gut Deutsch
und gut Englisch sprichst.

Besonders spannend finden wir

Windows-Infrastruktur: Terminalserver/RDS, Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien, Registry, PowerShell, Dienstkonten und Credential Manager.
AutoHotkey, Power Automate sowie UI- und Prozessautomatisierung unter Windows.
Robuste Integrationen: Idempotenz, Retry-/Timeout-Strategien, Queues, Locks, konkurrierende Dateizugriffe und Wiederanlauf nach Fehlern.
Microsoft-Ökosystem: Outlook, Exchange, Microsoft Graph, COM-/Office-Integrationen und Windows Printing APIs.
IPC und lokale Kommunikation: Named Pipes, localhost-APIs und vergleichbare Mechanismen.
Lokale Datenhaltung und Synchronisation, etwa SQLite, Offline-/Cache-Konzepte und Dokumenten-Workflows.
Enterprise- oder Legal-Tech-Software mit heterogenen lokalen Installationen, Softwareständen und administrierten Windows-Umgebungen.
AWS/S3, Git-basierte Delivery, automatisierte Builds, Tests und Release-Pipelines.
Legal Tech: Erfahrung z.B. mit RA-MICRO, DATEV, Advoware, TriNotar.

AutoHotkey oder Power Automate müssen nicht Deine Hauptwerkzeuge sein. Entscheidend ist, dass Du verstehst, wann Automatisierung sinnvoll ist – und wann sie durch eine saubere Softwareintegration ersetzt werden sollte.

Wie wir arbeiten

Hohe Ownership: Du lieferst Ergebnisse, nicht Tickets.
Wenig Hierarchie und kurze Entscheidungswege: technische Entscheidungen werden dort getroffen, wo das Wissen sitzt.
Schnell, aber mit Qualitätsanspruch: robuste Fehlerbehandlung, Tests, Logging und nachvollziehbare Architektur gehören zum Produkt.
Direkter Kontakt zu Kunden und Partnern ist Teil der Rolle – Produktverständnis ist genauso wichtig wie guter Code.
AI-Tools gehören für uns selbstverständlich zum Entwicklungsalltag. Entscheidend ist, dass Du verstehst, testest und verantwortest, was Du auslieferst.

Was wir Dir bieten

Sehr viel Ownership über einen strategisch wichtigen Produktbereich.
Großen Gestaltungsspielraum bei Architektur, Technologien und der nächsten Generation von KI:RSTEN Desktop.
Technische Herausforderungen deutlich jenseits klassischer Web- oder CRUD-Entwicklung.
Direkten Austausch mit Kunden, der Bundesnotarkammer und führenden Softwareanbietern.
Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkten Zugang zu Development, Product und Geschäftsleitung.
Attraktives Gehaltspaket und Top-IT-Equipment nach Wahl.
EGYM Wellpass.
Remote oder vor Ort: Modernes Büro direkt an der Theresienwiese in München; die Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder vollständig remote ausgeübt werden.

Deine ersten 30 / 60 / 90 Tage

30 Tage:
Du verstehst unsere Desktop-Architektur, die AutoHotkey-Codebase, die wichtigsten Integrationen und den Datenfluss zwischen Cloud und lokalen Systemen – und hast erste Änderungen produktiv ausgeliefert.
60 Tage:
Du übernimmst eigenständig eine größere Integration oder ein Desktop-Feature und verbesserst einen zentralen Bereich wie Synchronisation, Installer, Updates, Logging oder Prozessautomatisierung.
90 Tage:
Du verantwortest einen größeren Teil von KI:RSTEN Desktop technisch, hast die weitere Architektur mitgeprägt und setzt neue Integrationen von der ersten technischen Entscheidung bis zum produktiven Rollout eigenständig um.

Start: ab sofort.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our stream-aligned engineering teams. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. You'll work in a small, full-stack team of 2-3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production.
Deliver high quality features both individually and with other team members, working full-stack across whatever the stream requires.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design and develop features that deliver real-world value.
Contribute to technical decision-making within your stream, including surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.
Participate in creating a psychologically safe and happy environment within the team and the company.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, but you commit to travelling to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Experience with strongly typed languages (i.e., Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our tech stack quickly.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, and curious about how AI can improve how we build.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of secure development principles to building safe, trusted systems
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.
Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.
Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.
Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.
Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.
Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.
Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.
Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.
A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.
Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Application Support Developer Mainframe (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Application Support Developer Mainframe
beraten Kunden bei der Entwicklung, Optimierung und dem Betrieb von Softwarelösungen. Im Mainframe Umfeld unterstützen sie Kunden und Entwicklungsteams bei der Analyse technischer Herausforderungen, der Wartung und Weiterentwicklung geschäftskritischer Anwendungen sowie der Integration bestehender Host-Systeme, um stabile und effiziente Softwarelösungen bereitzustellen.

Verantwortlichkeiten

Anleiten des technischen Designs und der Architektur in Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams für Softwarelösungen und Mainframe-Anwendungen.
Leitung ausführlicher technischer Analysen und Problemlösungen zur Optimierung der Softwareleistung, Systemintegration sowie des Betriebs von Host- und Umsystemen.
Vorantreiben der Entwicklung und Implementierung von Codequalitätsstandards, Testverfahren und Überprüfungsprozessen zur Gewährleistung robuster und stabiler Softwareprodukte.
Koordinieren mit Projektmanagern und Fachbereichen, um die termingerechte Bereitstellung von Funktionen, Releasewechseln und technischen Lösungen sicherzustellen.
Unterstützung bei der Wartung und Weiterentwicklung von Mainframe-Anwendungen sowie Batchprozessen, Datenbanken und Systemumgebungen.
Anleitung und Unterstützung von Entwicklungsteams sowie Förderung von Coding Standards, Versionskontrolle und Best Practices.
Eigene Zuständigkeiten im Bereich der Verkaufsvorbereitung.
Erarbeitung von Wissen über neue Produkte, Prozesse, Methoden und Systeme.

Qualifikationen

Programmiersprachen: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit COBOL, idealerweise ergänzt durch Kenntnisse in PL/1, Assembler oder SQL.
Zusammenarbeit & Kommunikation: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholdern sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektro- und Informationstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

Mainframe-Technologien: Sicherer Umgang mit z/OS, TSO/ISPF, JCL, IBM DB2, IBM MQSeries, CICS sowie Host- und Umsystemen.
Versicherungsumfeld: Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Versicherungsprozessen und Bestandssystemen, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Bestandsführung, Vertragsmanagement, Schaden oder Tabex/4.
Batch & Job Scheduling: Erfahrung in der Steuerung, Überwachung und Planung von Batchprozessen sowie mit UC4 (Automic), JobSyncs und Job Resources.
Datenbanken & Datenmanagement: Kenntnisse in IBM DB2, SQL sowie im Umgang mit DbVisualizer und komplexen Datenbankabfragen.

Leistungen

Bei Expleo setzen wir auf Teamwork, Offenheit, Transparenz und Wertschätzung. Wir gehen unsere Aufgaben gemeinsam an
Bei uns erwartet dich ein internationales und multikulturelles Team
Bei uns sind alle gleich und wir tragen alle die gleiche Farbe: LILA!
Wir bieten dir Gleitzeit, ein ausführliches Onboarding, Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und unzählige Mitarbeiter-Benefits. Wir bieten einen Arbeitsplatz, der deine persönlichen Lebensumstände berücksichtigt und dich absichert
Man lernt nie aus: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns sehr am Herzen. Wir bieten interne Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und unterstützen dich und deine perspektivischen Ziele
Wir haben Lust etwas zu bewegen, uns gegenseitig zu motivieren und freuen uns, wenn auch du deinen Teil zum großen Ganzen beitragen: Deine Erfahrung, deine Ideen und dein Engagement finden bei uns Gehör und werden honoriert
Unsere Kunden können sich nicht nur sehen lassen; sie gehören zu den Top-Playern ihrer Branchen, in den Bereichen Banken und Versicherungen, Automotive, Luftfahrt, Transport, Life Science und viele mehr
Das soziale Miteinander ist uns wichtig. Wir setzen auf Teambuilding und Identifikation

Du willst mehr über uns wissen? Besuche einfach unseren Youtube-Kanal und schau Dir unsere Videos an. Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich persönlich kennenzulernen.

das volle Potential der Cloud ausschöpfen? , Hannover
, Köln
, München

.

Cloud Solution Design & Architecture: Entwickle cloud-native Lösungen und übersetze Anforderungen unserer Mandanten in skalierbare und sichere Architekturen.
Automation & Deployment: Implementiere CI/CD-Pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code und Monitoring-Frameworks für stabile Abläufe.

Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering

Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Department:
Technology
Location:
London

Description

Defaqto is one of the most trusted names in UK financial services research and ratings, and our technology turns deep market data into decisions that advisers, providers and consumers rely on every day. The credibility of that output rests on the quality of our engineering.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to be the most senior individual contributor in our Technology function. Reporting to the Head of Engineering and working closely with the CTO, you will own how we build software at Defaqto: our engineering standards and practices, our technical direction, and above all the shift from AI-assisted coding towards AI-led delivery, with engineers directing and verifying rather than typing.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role without the requirement of management, unless you are keen to do so. You will guide several squads, earning influence through judgement, craft and delivered outcomes. You will also take direct technical ownership of the initiatives that carry the most technical risk or the most upside at any given time. Our current focus is opening Defaqto data to developers and AI agents through well-governed APIs and MCP servers, but the role is defined by the level you operate at, not by any one product — expect what you own to change as our priorities do.

You will also be a genuine sounding board for technology leadership, as comfortable shaping a multi-year technical strategy as unblocking a production problem this afternoon. If you are the engineer other engineers go to when a decision really matters, and you want the remit to raise the bar across a whole organisation rather than a single team, this is that role.

What you'll do

Lead our shift from AI-assisted coding to AI-led delivery
Own the trajectory: take us from engineers using assistants to help write code, to engineers directing agents that write it — with the human firmly in the loop as architect, reviewer and accountable owner rather than as the typist.
Define what good looks like at each step of that shift: context and prompt engineering, agent-readable codebases (clear structure, strong typing, rich tests, machine-readable specs and repository guidance), and tooling that makes agent output reproducible rather than lucky.
Make the review layer the new craft. Raise our standards for reading, verifying and hardening generated code: tests as the contract, static analysis and security scanning inside the loop, and no unreviewed AI-authored change reaching production.
Rebuild our practices around specification over syntax, so engineers spend their time on problem framing, acceptance criteria, architecture and verification instead of on implementation keystrokes.
Run structured experiments with new models, agents and workflows. Measure lead time, change failure rate, review burden and developer experience, and retire anything that does not earn its place.
Set the guardrails that make this safe in a regulated business: secure and licence-aware tooling, provenance and auditability for generated code, client and personal data kept inside approved boundaries, and a named human accountable for everything that ships.
Take the organisation with you. Coach engineers through the identity shift from writing code to engineering outcomes, and make the sceptics as fluent as the enthusiasts.

Turn developer practices into engineering practices
Move us beyond individual developer habits to engineering discipline that holds at organisational scale — and at the change volume that agentic delivery produces.
Codify practice into the paved road: templates, scaffolds, pipelines, linters, policy-as-code, automated checks and agent instructions, so the right thing is the easy thing for humans and agents alike.
Define, document and continuously evolve the engineering standards that apply across Defaqto Technology — code review, testing, branching, observability, security by design, documentation and definition of done.
Hold the line on quality in a way teams welcome: coaching, pairing and reviewing rather than policing. Be our evangelist for software craftsmanship, and help raise the hiring bar to match it.

Take hands-on technical ownership of the problems that matter most
Own the initiatives that carry the most technical risk or the most upside, end to end — architecture, build, launch and the operational reality afterwards. What that is will change as our priorities do; the level at which you operate will not.
Design platforms and integration surfaces for both the consumers we have and the ones we are gaining: human developers and AI agents. Machine-readable capability discovery, unambiguous tool definitions, MCP servers and other agent-facing interfaces where they fit, semantics an agent can reason over, predictable errors, idempotency, and rate limiting that behaves sensibly under agentic access patterns.
Build data governance into the technology rather than into a policy handbook: entitlements and licensing enforced at the point of access, per-consumer scoping, lineage and provenance carried with the data, and full audit of which human or agent accessed what, and when.
Make quality and trust observable — data contracts, freshness and quality signals exposed to consumers, and semantics clear enough that a consumer cannot silently misread a rating or a field.
Care about the consumption experience end to end: self-service onboarding, keys and sandboxes, SDKs, documentation as a product, usage analytics, versioning and deprecation. Treat time to first successful call, by a person or an agent, as a metric you own.

Partner with Product to add technology value
Act as the technical validation point for product ideas, pressure-testing feasibility, cost, risk and sequencing early, before commitments are made.
Bring technology-led opportunities to the table: things our data, platform and AI capability make possible that Product had not thought to ask for.
Translate between commercial intent and technical reality in both directions, without diluting either.

Guide squads and evolve the tech stack
Guide multiple teams within your squad towards sound, well-supported technology choices, and away from novelty for its own sake.
Own continuous improvement of the tech stack with clear, valued outcomes: every material change carries a stated benefit, a measure and a migration plan.
Lead the architecture decisions that cross team boundaries, document them as ADRs, and keep our technical debt position honest and visible.

Be a strategic and tactical sounding board
Act as trusted counsel to the Head of Engineering, the CTO and the wider leadership team on both long-range strategy and this week’s trade-offs.
Represent engineering reality in commercial, regulatory and roadmap conversations.
Stay hands-on — build, review and verify on the work that matters most.

What you'll need to succeed:

Essential requirements:
Substantial commercial software engineering experience, including time at staff, principal or equivalent level, with a track record of technical influence well beyond your own team.
Deep, current, hands-on engineering ability in a modern stack, with the breadth to stay credible outside your strongest language. Our core stack is a mix of .NET / C# and TypeScript on Azure, Python and PHP, with SQL and modern data tooling.
Real, evidenced experience leading agentic and AI-assisted development in a production engineering organisation — not just personal use of an assistant. You can show how you changed a team’s practices, what you measured, and how you kept quality and accountability intact.
A clear point of view on the engineering practices that make AI-led delivery work: specification and context engineering, test-first contracts, agent-readable codebases, and review as a first-class discipline.
Demonstrable ownership of engineering standards and practices across multiple teams: you have written them, embedded them in tooling, and actually changed behaviour with them.
Strong API and integration engineering: designing, versioning, securing and operating interfaces consumed by other people’s systems — and increasingly by their agents — with real care for the consumer experience around them.
Treats data governance as an engineering problem: entitlements, licensing, lineage, provenance and auditability enforced in the technology rather than asserted in a policy document.
Sound distributed systems and cloud architecture judgement — resilience, observability, performance, cost and operability, not just diagrams.
Excellent influencing and communication skills: you build consensus across teams and can hold your own with product, commercial and executive audiences.
Commercial instinct — you tie technical work to outcomes the business recognises and can measure.
A mentoring track record: senior engineers have become materially better because they worked with you.
Comfort with a moving remit. You are motivated by owning whichever problem is hardest right now, not by owning one system indefinitely.

Desirable requirements:
Experience building or operating agent-facing integration surfaces — MCP servers, tool-calling interfaces or similar.
Financial services, fintech or regulated data experience, and comfort treating FCA and UK GDPR / ICO expectations as design constraints rather than afterthoughts.
Experience with data products, business intelligence or analytics platforms — data modelling, contracts, quality, lineage and entitlements.
Experience of a developer portal, API marketplace or platform-as-a-product.
Platform engineering and developer experience work: CI/CD, internal developer platforms, golden paths, policy-as-code and self-service tooling.
Event-driven architecture, and experience of legacy modernisation or migration programmes.
Contribution to the wider engineering community — open source, writing, speaking or standards work.

Your approach to work:
Pragmatic. You optimise for outcomes and maintainability, not for elegance or novelty.
Generous. You make other engineers better, and you take real pleasure in it.
Evidence-led. You hold strong opinions loosely and change your mind when the data says so.
Direct and kind. You disagree well, in the open, and commit fully once a decision is made.
Curious and current. You keep learning fast in a field that is moving fast, and you bring what you learn back to the organisation.
Steady under pressure. You are the calm one when something is on fire.

Important to know:

Location:
Hybrid — London or Haddenham office, with the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. You will spend regular time on site with your squads and with product and leadership colleagues.

Right to Work:

Applicants must already hold a legal right to work in the UK without time restrictions and without the need for future sponsorship. We are unable to provide Skilled Worker visa sponsorship.

Fintel plc and all the businesses within it adopt a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination on any of the protected grounds in the Equality Act 2010.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all current and prospective employees regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership.

We aspire to have a diverse workforce because, in our view, diversity enables better business outcomes. We also believe that a more inclusive workplace, where people of different backgrounds work together, ensures better outcomes for all staff. From application to interview, we place inclusion at the heart of all we do.

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
Methods Analytics (MA) is recruiting for a Data Architect to join our team a permanent basis.

This role will be mainly remote but require flexibility to travel to client sites, and our offices based in London, Sheffield, and Bristol.

What You'll Be Doing as a Data Architect:

Advocate the business benefit of data standards, championing and governing those standards across projects and the organisation
Demonstrate an overall perspective on business issues and activities, determining patterns, standards, policies, roadmaps and vision statements
Make and guide effective decisions, explaining clearly how decisions have been reached and resolving technical disputes across varying levels of complexity and risk
Communicate effectively across organisational, technical and political boundaries, making complex technical information accessible for non-technical audiences
Design how to expose data from systems (APIs, real-time streams), link data from multiple systems, and deliver modern data services
Ensure that risks associated with deployment are adequately understood and documented
Design end-to-end data solutions from requirements through implementation, including technical documentation and architecture blueprints
Lead complex data migration projects from legacy systems to modern cloud-native platforms
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies across the modern data stack to meet specific client needs
Mentor junior team members and collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders

Your Impact:

Enable transformative business decisions through robust, scalable data architectures
Drive adoption of modern data platforms and AI-enabled analytics solutions
Establish technical standards and architectural patterns that ensure quality, security, and maintainability
Help cultivate a data-driven culture within client organisations and internally
Deliver architectures that seamlessly integrate traditional and modern data systems

Requirements

You Will Demonstrate:

Deep knowledge of the Azure data stack (Azure SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Data Factory, Purview, Synapse, Event Hub, Azure Databricks/Fabric)
Extensive data modelling experience: both normalised relational models and de-normalised Star Schema/dimensional models
Excellent relational database design skills with expertise in diagnosing and optimising performance across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud databases
Proven track record with complex data migration projects (terabyte+ datasets, multiple legacy source systems, structures and unstructured data)
Proficiency with Parquet/Delta Lake or other modern data storage formats
Experience with streaming architectures using Kafka, Event Hubs, or Kinesis for real-time data processing
Knowledge of data architectures supporting AI/ML workloads, including vector databases, feature stores and MLOps pipelines
Experience processing and managing unstructured data types (text, images, logs, sensor data)
Understanding of Lambda and Kappa architectural patterns and when to apply each

You May Also Have:

Exposure to high-performing, low latency or large volume data systems
Knowledge of and/or experience with Government Digital Service practices across Discovery/Alpha/Beta/Live phases
Understanding of vector databases and similarity search for AI applications
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and modern DevOps practices
Knowledge of how to design and analyse operational logs for data processing, and triage incidents
Awareness of advances in AI technologies, data services, and architectural practices
Industry specialisation in specific sectors (Engineering, Manufacturing, Healthcare etc.)
Public sector or defence experience
Experience with modern unified data platforms like Databricks or Microsoft Fabric
Understanding of data mesh or data fabric architectural approaches
Relevant industry certifications such as TOGAF 9, CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Security Clearance:

UKSV (United Kingdom Security Vetting) clearance is required for this role, with Security Check (SC) as the minimum standard, either already held or with a willingness to undergo the process. Some roles/projects may require Developed Vetting (DV) clearance; while not mandatory, a willingness to obtain DV clearance would be beneficial. As part of the onboarding process candidates will be asked to complete a Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS); details of the evidence required to apply may be found on the government website GOV.UK - Government baseline personnel security standard. If you are unable to meet this and any associated criteria, then your employment may be delayed, or rejected. Details of this will be discussed with you at interview.

Our Hiring Process

At Methods Analytics, we believe in a transparent hiring process. Here's what you can expect:

Internal Application Review
Initial Phone Screen
Technical Interview
Collaborative Technical Exercise
Final Interview
Offer

Benefits

Working at MA

Methods Analytics (MA) exists to improve society by helping people make better decisions with data. Combining passionate people, sector-specific insight, and technical excellence to provide our customers an end-to-end data service.

We use a collaborative, creative and user centric approach to data to do good and solve difficult problems. Ensuring that our outputs are transparent, robust, and transformative. We value discussion and debate as part of our approach. We will question assumptions, ambition, and process - but do so with respect and humility.

We relish difficult problems, and overcome them with innovation, creativity, and technical freedom to help us design optimum solutions. Ethics, privacy, and quality are at the heart of our work, and we will not sacrifice these for outcomes.

We treat data with respect and use it only for the right purpose. Our people are positive, dedicated, and relentless. Data is a vast topic, but we strive for interactions that are engaging, informative and fun in equal measure. But maintain a steely focus on outcomes and delivering quality products for our customers.

We are passionate about our people; we want our colleagues to develop the things they are good at and enjoy.

By joining us you can expect

Autonomy to develop and grow your skills and experience
Be part of exciting project work that is making a difference in society
Strong, inspiring, and thought-provoking leadership

jobs.title: Software Engineers
jobs.description:
MSAB is a global leader in digital forensic technology for mobile device examination and analysis. The MSAB vision is to empower every investigation with digital forensic solutions – for a safer world. A core value is to run an ethics-driven company with innovation and results. The sole focus of MSAB is on delivering high quality digital forensic solutions to collect, review, analyze and manage data. MSAB is a trusted partner to Law Enforcement, Defence Forces, Government Agencies and Forensic Laboratories in democratic countries throughout the world enabling them to investigate crime, gather intelligence, investigate fraud and fight corruption.

To our new Stockholm office we’re looking for two engineers to join our Unicore team. You enjoy building systems that are not only functional, but also efficient, scalable, and thoughtfully designed. This is a chance to work with technology with a purpose – to create a safer world.

The job

At MSAB, the Unicore team is responsible for the core of our digital forensics platform, including UNIFY and the XRY file format (Core API). We’re now working on the next generation of UNIFY, and this is an opportunity to help shape it from the inside.

In this role, you will work with core system development where performance and reliability are critical. You’ll be dealing with distributed systems and data-intensive workloads, contributing to architectural decisions with long-term impact, and exploring how to best leverage hardware such as CPU and GPU.

Our current tech stack includes C99, C++20, and C# (.NET 8/10), along with gRPC, SQLite and PostgreSQL, running across both Windows and Linux environments.

Who You Are

We believe you will thrive in this environment if you have a genuine interest in programming and problem-solving, and if you care about performance, clean design, and user experience. You likely enjoy systems engineering, think in terms of trade-offs, and prefer solving meaningful problems over fitting into rigid roles. An appreciation for simplicity and keeping dependencies lean will serve you well.

Your Experience

You will benefit from your experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, containerization with Docker, or cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure which is considered a plus.
You will be part of a focused team working close to the core of the product, where your decisions matter and your code has real impact.

Interested, or know someone who might be? Reach out or apply — we’d love to connect.

There is much more to talk about, like values, our growth plans, technology choices etc., but we save that for the interview.

Welcome to apply now!

For more information about MSAB, please visit: http://www.msab.com

What we can offer

Create a safer world with us!
As one of the world’s leading digital forensics companies, MSAB leads the way in pioneering advancements that contribute to making our world safer.

Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment

In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. We highly value flexibility, giving you the option to work from home, your local office, or find a balance that suits your needs.

Why join us?

You’ll play a central role in driving digital transformation for our customers. You’ll gain broad visibility into complex ecosystems—and real ownership of key areas. You’ll work closely with a friendly and experienced team.
We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Salary range: 5200-7800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

jobs.title: Portfolio Architect
jobs.description:
Basware is a global leader in cloud-based purchase-to-pay and e-invoicing solutions, processing billions of transactions annually for enterprise customers across 100+ countries. With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

As Portfolio Architect
you will own the end-to-end architectural vision for Basware’s product portfolio. You will bridge product strategy, engineering delivery, data and AI innovation — ensuring that our platform evolves coherently, scalably, and with AI-first thinking embedded from the ground up.

You will report into senior technology leadership and work in close partnership with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to set technical direction, govern architectural standards, and accelerate the adoption of LLMs, agentic systems, and ML pipelines across the portfolio.

What You'll Do

Architecture Leadership

Define and evolve the portfolio-level technical architecture across Basware’s product suite, ensuring coherence, scalability, and strategic alignment
Set architectural review processes for AI and set engineering standards that span teams and products
Identify architectural risk, technical debt, and opportunities for platform consolidation.

AI/ML Platform Strategy

Lead architectural decisions across LLMs, agentic workflows, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and ML inference infrastructure
Define the approach for integrating AI capabilities into core product flows — from document intelligence to autonomous process automation
Evaluate and select AI tooling and frameworks; build the internal knowledge base around responsible experimentation and production readiness.

MLOps & Governance

Own the MLOps architecture: model training pipelines, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and continuous evaluation
Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, bias detection, data privacy, and regulatory compliance
Drive standardised approaches to model lifecycle management across product teams.

Strategic Partnership

Act as a trusted technical advisor to product leadership, translating architecture decisions into roadmap impact
Represent Basware’s technical direction in customer-facing conversations, analyst briefings, and partnership discussions
Mentor and elevate engineering talent across the organisation; establish communities of practice around architecture and AI.

,

Essential

What We're Looking For

Proven experience as a Solution, Portfolio or Principal Architect at a $300M+ ARR SaaS company
Fluent in using with modern AI tooling and integrating them naturally into spec-driven development, architecture design, technical planning, etc
Demonstrable understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and regulatory considerations (e.g. EU AI Act awareness)
Strong track record of defining and communicating architectural vision to diverse audiences — engineers, executives, and customers
Deep cloud-native architecture experience on AWS or Azure
Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce crisp, persuasive technical narratives

Highly Desirable

Domain experience in fintech, accounts payable automation, procurement, or enterprise financial workflows
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture at enterprise scale
Background in enterprise integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API-first design
Hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering — specifically in one or more of: LLMs, agentic systems, vector stores, RAG architectures, and ML pipelines
Practical experience with MLOps tooling and practices (e.g. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent)
Prior experience contributing to or leading architectural governance bodies (e.g. Tech Council, Architecture Review Board)

Location & Ways of Working

This is a remote-first role. We are open to candidates based anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast (broadly UTC−5 to UTC+2). You should expect to travel to key Basware hubs a few times per year for planning cycles, offsites, and customer engagements.

What We Offer

A high-impact role at the centre of Basware’s AI transformation — with real influence over product direction
Competitive base salary benchmarked to senior architecture talent in your market, plus performance-linked bonus
Remote-first flexibility with a strong, distributed engineering culture
Annual learning & development budget for conferences, certifications, and research

Why Basware?

We’re a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you’ll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence.

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited by the challenge, apply now and help shape the future of Basware.

Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the ‘ I’m interested ’ link.

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check.

Basware. Now it all just happens.
