jobs.title: Senior .Net udvikler til afdeling i vækst
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

Vil du være med til at skabe fremtidens IT-løsninger og arbejde i en virksomhed, hvor din udvikling og trivsel er i fokus? Hvis ja, er du måske vores nye Senior eller Lead .Net Udvikler til vores Code team. Her får du chancen for at spille en central rolle i den fortsatte opbygning af en fremadstormende konsulentvirksomhed.

Hvem er Sopra Steria?

Sopra Steria er en IT-konsulentforretning med fokus på softwareudvikling, projektledelse og data/analyse. Vi hjælper i dag særligt finansielle institutioner og den offentlige sektor med at nå deres ambitioner. Vi kombinerer moderne teknologi og en solid forretningsforståelse for at sikre, at vi finder løsninger, som både er attraktive, værdiskabende og er teknisk mulige at gennemføre samt implementere. Vi er med fra start til slut.

Siden 2015 har vi været i top-10 som ”Danmarks bedste it-virksomhed” i ”Great Place To Works” årlige undersøgelse, og vi er i høj grad drevet af at skabe et godt, socialt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på resultater og det gode arbejdsliv i balance. Det er fundamentalt for os, at vores medarbejdere har det godt, og syntes at det er sjovt at gå på arbejde, det er sådan vi skaber de bedste resultater.

Hvad skal du lave?

Som senior .NET udvikler vil du have en central rolle i at lede og rådgive vores kunder i komplekse IT-projekter. Din ekspertise inden for Microsoft-teknologier og produkter er afgørende for at sikre, at vores løsninger ikke blot imødekommer, men også overstiger kundernes forventninger. Du bliver en nøglespiller i at oversætte kundens forretningsbehov til tekniske løsninger samtidig med, at du sikrer, at alle interessenter er involveret og informeret gennem klar og effektiv kommunikation.

Du vil ikke blot udvikle software, men også være ansvarlig for at definere opgaver og estimere projektomfang. Din evne til at navigere i komplekse forretningsprocesser og arbejdsgange vil være afgørende for at sikre, at vores løsninger integreres problemfrit i kundens miljø.

Vi værdsætter din evne til at forudsige og imødekomme ændringer hos vores kunder og forventer, at du tager ansvar for at sikre, at alle projekter bliver en succes. Du vil dagligt arbejde tæt sammen med kunder enten på deres lokation, hjemmefra eller fra vores kontor i centrum af København. Her bliver du en del af et dynamisk team af passionerede kollegaer med rig mulighed for at udvikle dine færdigheder.

Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren og initiativrig konsulent, der trives med at være dybt involveret i kundens forretning. Du ser det som din fornemmeste opgave at udfordre status quo for at sikre de mest optimale løsninger. Som holdspiller bidrager du aktivt til et inspirerende fagligt fællesskab og stræber efter konstant at udvikle dine kompetencer. Din selvstændighed og evne til at navigere i udfordrende situationer gør dig særligt velegnet i et miljø, hvor rammerne løbende formes, og hvor du aktivt medvirker til at definere din egen rolle.

Vi værdsætter dine personlige egenskaber højt, især din evne til at arbejde tæt sammen med kunderne og være opsøgende og proaktiv i din tilgang. Som engageret og nysgerrig udvikler er du drevet af at løse problemer og udforske nye muligheder.

Vi ser gerne at du...

Har solid erfaring med C# og .NET,
Mestre traditionel web udvikling (ASP.NET and MVC),
API integrationer, REST,
Databaser teknologier som SQL, NoSQL, Entity Framework,
Er flydende i dansk, både skriftlig og mundtlig.
Erfaring fra konsulenthus.

Det er herudover en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med...

Frontend frameworks som Angular, React, Vue.js eller .NET Blazor,
Cloud platforme som AWS, Azure eller GCP (Google),
DevOps, CD/CI,
Agil udvikling, Scrum eller tilsvarende.
Erfaring fra projekter i den finansielle eller offentlige sektor.

Bliv en del af os

Her får du altså muligheden for at blive en del af en organisation i rivende udvikling, som er kendt for at skabe stærke relationer både internt og med vores kunder. Og sidst men ikke mindst bliver du en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor videndeling og sparring er i højsædet.

Vi tilbyder:

Søde og passionerede kollegaer, som glæder sig til at arbejde sammen med dig.
En uformel og sjov hverdag på en spændende arbejdsplads med sociale og hjælpsomme kolleger.
Gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling: seminarer, konferencer, coaching, sparring, certificeringer mv.
Regelmæssige sociale arrangementer som fredagsbar, onsdagstræning, sommerfest etc.
Fleksibel arbejdsplads med mulighed for at arbejde fra vores kontor i København i kombination med hjemmearbejdsdage.

Er du klar til at tage det næste skridt i din karriere og blive en del af Sopra Steria? Send os dit CV og eventuelt en motiveret ansøgning allerede i dag, så vi kan starte dialogen om, hvordan vi kan skabe værdi sammen.

Vi ser frem til at læse dit CV!

Yderligere oplysninger

Vi er en af nordens førende konsulentvirksomheder inden for digitalisering, innovation og moderne teknologi og gennem mange år har vi været rangeret som en af Danmarks bedste IT-arbejdspladser.

Som en af nordens største konsulentvirksomheder bistår vi store private virksomheder og offentlige organisationer med deres digitale omstilling.

Vi lægger vægt på at skabe værdi for vores kunder og samfundet og har som mål at skabe en bedre og mere bæredygtig fremtid.

Freelance Opportunities

Vi samarbejder løbende med erfarne freelancekonsulenter på tværs af en bred vifte af ingeniør- og teknologiprojekter. Hvis du er interesseret i fremtidige freelanceopgaver hos Etteplan, vil vi meget gerne lære dig at kende. Send os dit CV, så kontakter vi dig, når vi ser en mulighed, der matcher din erfaring og dine kompetencer.

Om Etteplan

Etteplan er en international ingeniør- og teknologivirksomhed, som hjælper industrielle virksomheder med at designe, udvikle og forbedre produkter, systemer og digitale løsninger.

I Danmark er vi i gang med at udvide vores tilstedeværelse og opbygger et netværk af erfarne fullstack software engineers, som er interesserede i at arbejde med os på kommende projekter.

Vores teams arbejder med softwareudvikling, cloud-platforme og digitale løsninger på tværs af brancher som produktion, energi, life science og industriel teknologi.

Om rollen

Vi søger fullstack software engineers, som har lyst til at arbejde på udvikling af moderne softwareløsninger på tværs af backend og frontend.

Du vil typisk arbejde med udvikling af nye systemer, videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger samt integration af komplekse platforme.

Rollen indebærer ofte tæt samarbejde med andre udviklere, arkitekter og forretningsinteressenter, hvor du både bidrager til teknisk implementering og løsningsdesign.

Typiske teknologier

Backend: Java, .NET, Node.js, Python
Frontend: React, Angular, Vue
JavaScript / TypeScript
API’er (REST, GraphQL)
Cloud: AWS, Azure

Hvem vi typisk leder efter

Vi er som udgangspunkt interesserede i profiler, der har:

solid erfaring med både backend- og frontend-udvikling
erfaring med minimum én backend-teknologi (fx Java, .NET, Node.js eller Python)
erfaring med moderne frontend frameworks som React, Angular eller Vue
erfaring med at udvikle skalerbare og vedligeholdbare softwareløsninger
erfaring med at arbejde i agile og samarbejdsorienterede teams

Derfor søger vi profilen

Vi arbejder løbende på nye projekter i Danmark og vil gerne være i dialog med fullstack engineers, der kunne være interesserede i fremtidige opgaver hos Etteplan.

Selvom der ikke nødvendigvis er et konkret projekt lige nu, tager vi ofte fat i kandidater fra vores netværk, når nye muligheder opstår.

Hvad sker der, når du søger

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende.

Hvis din profil matcher et kommende projekt, kontakter vi dig for en uforpligtende dialog om mulighederne.

Din profil kan også blive en del af vores konsulentnetværk til fremtidige projekter.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Teradyne, Singapore)
jobs.description:
About Teradyne

Teradyne is a leading supplier of Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) used to test complex electronics in the consumer electronics, automotive, computing, telecommunications, aerospace, and defense industries. Teradyne helps bring high-quality innovations in smart devices, life-saving medical equipment, and data storage systems to market faster through its advanced test solutions for semiconductors and electronic systems.

In 2023, Teradyne generated $2.7 billion in revenue and employed approximately 6,500 people worldwide.

The Semiconductor Test Division is the world's largest supplier of semiconductor test equipment for logic, RF, analog, power, mixed-signal, and memory technologies. The Nextest division is responsible for the Magnum family of memory test products.

For more information, visit www.teradyne.com .

Our Purpose

At Teradyne, experience meets innovation as we drive excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity, diversity of thought, and the strength of our workforce. Our employees are driven to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate an inclusive culture that respects each employee’s strengths, perspectives, and experiences. We believe our differences make us a stronger team—one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers stronger business results.

Organization & Role

Nextest is looking for software engineers to join an exciting, dynamic, hardworking, engaging, and collaborative team. As an individual contributor, you will be involved in all aspects of software engineering and complex problem-solving, working with cross-functional teams to define, implement, and test new features and functionality.

Nextest engineering teams bring deep technical expertise across both software and hardware. Our engineers thrive in a dynamic, customer-driven, global work environment where they succeed through innovation and collaboration. Internally, we work closely with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, and QA. Externally, we partner with Field Support and customers to deliver impactful solutions.

Opportunity Overview

In this role, you will:

Understand customer requirements and find innovative ways to incorporate them into our existing software architecture.
Learn from our most senior engineers while bringing your own experience and perspective to help drive the next generation of Teradyne solutions.
Collaborate with our senior team to design and develop programs and libraries for new products.
Assist with sustaining and extending programs and libraries for existing products.
Engage with our Field Applications team to find innovative ways to improve customer success and solve customer problems.
Work with the Software QA group to develop effective test strategies, identify improvement areas, and resolve issues in internal and customer-facing software releases.

All About You

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
Expert-level proficiency in C++ and/or C# with strong object-oriented design and programming skills.
Strong experience developing software that interfaces directly with hardware, including FPGA-, ASIC-, or instrument-based systems.
Solid hands-on experience with .NET application development.
Strong understanding of software quality practices, including unit testing, automated testing, and continuous integration methodologies.
Proficiency in Windows application development and debugging using Microsoft Visual Studio.
Strong knowledge of the C++ Standard Template Library (STL) and modern C++ development practices.
Experience with source code management and collaborative development tools, including Git/GitLab, code review processes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Jira or similar Agile project management tools for requirement tracking, sprint planning, and issue management.
Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring engineering teams.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to cross-functional teams.
Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
Good command of written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive experience collaborating with hardware engineering teams, including interpreting schematics, hardware specifications, and design documentation.
Experience developing Windows device drivers, particularly using the Kernel-Mode Driver Framework (KMDF).
Strong understanding of Windows operating system internals and low-level system programming.
Proven track record of successfully delivering commercial products to customers.
Experience with instrument control, measurement systems, or test equipment software development.
Experience in Automated Test Equipment (ATE) systems, preferably in semiconductor memory testing.
Experience developing Windows-based GUI applications using WPF, MFC, or similar frameworks.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Multi-threaded and high-performance software development.
Software architecture and system-level design experience.
Experience with distributed systems, data analytics, or test data processing.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and DevOps practices.
Familiarity with semiconductor test methodologies, memory devices (DRAM, NAND Flash, HBM), and associated test flows is highly desirable.

Benefits

Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well-being benefits, including outpatient medical coverage, flexible benefits, life and disability insurance, paid vacation and holidays, and more.

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Solution Architect to join our ever-evolving Payouts team and help shape the future of global commerce.

You will define target architectures, set engineering standards, and work closely with product, platform, and delivery teams to translate business goals into robust technical solutions. Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Design
Define target and transitional architectures for microservices-based systems, including domain boundaries, service contracts, and data ownership.
Create and maintain architecture artifacts: context diagrams, sequence diagrams, service interaction models, API specifications, and deployment topologies.
Select and standardize architectural patterns (e.g., event-driven architecture, choreography vs. orchestration, CQRS, saga patterns, API gateway/BFF).
Ensure designs address non-functional requirements: scalability, reliability, performance, security, observability, and cost efficiency.

Technical Leadership
Provide hands-on guidance to engineering teams on service decomposition, API design, data modeling, and cloud-native implementation.
Establish and champion coding and design standards, reference implementations, and reusable templates.
Conduct architecture reviews, threat modeling, and design walkthroughs; manage technical risk and drive remediation plans.

Governance and Quality
Define guardrails for microservices (e.g., versioning, backward compatibility, resilience patterns, health checks, retries/circuit breakers, idempotency).
Partner with platform/DevOps teams to ensure CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and runtime policies align with architectural standards.
Drive observability-by-design: metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and incident postmortems.

Stakeholder Collaboration
Work with product managers to align technical roadmaps with business outcomes and OKRs.
Communicate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; facilitate trade-off discussions.
Collaborate with Security, Compliance, and Data teams to meet regulatory and data governance requirements.

Roadmapping and Innovation
Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and managed services; perform proofs of concept and ROI assessments.
Contribute to the evolution of domain-driven design across the organization; mentor engineers and junior architects.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years in software engineering/architecture with 4+ years designing and delivering microservices at scale.
Strong proficiency in:
Domain-Driven Design (DDD), bounded contexts, and service granularity.
API design (RESTful, gRPC) and event-driven patterns (Kafka, Pulsar, SNS/SQS, or similar).
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and core services (e.g., ECS/EKS/AKS/GKE, API Gateway, Lambda/Functions, IAM).
Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and ingress.
Data architectures for microservices: polyglot persistence, transactional boundaries, eventual consistency, and streaming.
Reliability and scalability patterns: circuit breakers, bulkheads, timeouts, backoff/retry, rate limiting, caching.
Observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, Jaeger/Zipkin.
CI/CD and DevSecOps: GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), security scanning, secrets management.

Solid experience with at least one modern language and framework (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js, Go, or Python/FastAPI).
Demonstrated track record leading complex programs from architecture through production, including migration from monoliths to microservices.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

It’s a bonus if you have

Experience in regulated or high-availability domains (e.g., payments, fintech, healthcare, e-commerce).
Familiarity with zero-downtime deployments, blue/green and canary strategies, feature flags, and progressive delivery.
Knowledge of API management platforms and developer portals.
Security expertise: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, secrets rotation, tokenization, and threat modeling.
Performance engineering: capacity planning, load testing, and cost optimization.
Event streaming design at scale: exactly-once semantics, schema evolution (e.g., Avro/Protobuf with schema registry).
Experience with multi-region, active-active architectures and disaster recovery.

jobs.description:
Beschrijving

Voor onze partner in regio Mechelen zijn we op zoek naar een Senior Agentic Software Engineer die een verschil wil maken. Je komt terecht in een innovatieve R&D-omgeving waar softwareontwikkeling en artificiële intelligentie steeds meer hand in hand gaan.

Samen met een multidisciplinair Scrum-team ontwikkel je moderne cloud-native applicaties op het Microsoft-platform. Je bouwt niet alleen kwalitatieve software, maar speelt ook een actieve rol in de transformatie naar AI-assisted en agentic softwareontwikkeling.

Waar softwareontwikkeling vroeger voornamelijk draaide om het handmatig schrijven van code, werk je vandaag steeds vaker samen met AI-systemen. Je gebruikt AI-tools en software agents om analyses uit te voeren, code te genereren, testen op te zetten, documentatie te creëren en repetitieve engineeringtaken te automatiseren.

Als Senior Agentic Software Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor zowel het ontwikkelen van schaalbare softwareoplossingen als het optimaal inzetten van AI binnen het ontwikkelproces. Je helpt mee de software development lifecycle van morgen vorm te geven en draagt actief bij aan de verdere uitbouw van engineering standaarden, best practices en AI-governance binnen het team.

Greep Uit Jouw Verantwoordelijkheden

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van schaalbare softwareoplossingen op basis van .NET en Azure.
Actief inzetten van AI-tools zoals GitHub Copilot, Claude Code en vergelijkbare oplossingen als onderdeel van je dagelijkse workflow.
Complexe businessvraagstukken vertalen naar opdrachten die efficiënt door AI-systemen kunnen worden uitgevoerd.
Reviewen, valideren en verbeteren van AI-gegenereerde code, documentatie en analyses.
Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Samenwerken met architecten, product owners en business analisten om kwalitatieve softwareoplossingen te realiseren.
Bijdragen aan technische standaarden, softwarekwaliteit en de verdere professionalisering van AI-gedreven development.
Ondersteunen van collega's bij het adopteren van AI-tools en nieuwe manieren van softwareontwikkeling.

Profiel

Je behaalde een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een relevante richting (Toegepaste Informatica, Software Engineering, Computer Science...).
Je beschikt over minimaal 6 jaar ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling met .NET-technologieën.
Je hebt ervaring met meerdere van onderstaande technologieën:
C#
.NET 10 (of eerdere moderne .NET-versies)
ASP.NET Core
RESTful API's
CQRS
Domain Driven Design (DDD)
React
Azure Cloud
GitHub Enterprise
GitHub Copilot
Bicep
Je denkt in architectuur, schaalbaarheid en lange termijn onderhoudbaarheid.
Je bent in staat AI-output kritisch te beoordelen en waar nodig te verbeteren.
Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid belangrijker zijn dan louter snelheid.
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en experimenteert graag met AI-tools.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.

Nice-to-haves

Ervaring met AI-assisted software development.
Kennis van Large Language Models (LLM's).
Ervaring met prompt engineering of context engineering.
Kennis van AI agents en agentic workflows.
Ervaring met Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Azure AI Services.
Observability & monitoring.
DevOps en platform engineering.

Aanbod

Maaltijd- en ecocheques
Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering
Bedrijfsrestaurant met zeer gunstige prijzen

D’identifier, comprendre et répondre aux besoins des clients,

Do you want to turn business challenges into smart, scalable solutions with Microsoft Power Platform? At Tieto Tech Consulting, we work at the intersection of technology, consulting, and customer value - helping organizations automate processes and build modern digital solutions that make daily work easier and more impactful.

With over 8,000 colleagues worldwide and around 300 colleagues in the DACH region, we combine industry insight, software engineering, cloud expertise, data capabilities, and enterprise solutions know-how to help our customers design, build, and run their digital businesses.

Define and own end-to-end Power Platform architectures, ensuring scalable, secure and sustainable solution designs across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages

A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable qualification

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
¡Hola! Somos OGA

Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.

Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.

Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.

Sobre la posición.

Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web, tanto en el lado del servidor como en el lado del cliente, para unirse a nuestro equipo.

¿Qué harás?

Desarrollarás Software, tanto en Backend como en Frontend.

Diseñarás, desarrollarás y mantendrás aplicaciones web completas, trabajando tanto en el frontend (Angular) como en el backend (.NET), asegurando un código limpio, mantenible y de alta calidad.

Propondrás y definirás arquitecturas de software escalables, eficientes y seguras, alineadas con las necesidades del negocio y las mejores prácticas del sector.

Crearás y consumirás APIs RESTful o GraphQL para garantizar una comunicación fluida entre las capas del frontend y backend, así como con servicios externos.

Diseñarás y administrarás bases de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) y NoSQL (MongoDB, etc.), asegurando un acceso eficiente, seguro y adaptado al volumen de datos esperado.

Configurarás y mantendrás pipelines de integración y entrega continua, automatizando pruebas, builds y despliegues en entornos cloud o on-premise.

Actuarás como referente técnico, proporcionando retroalimentación constructiva en revisiones de código, guiando a desarrolladores junior y promoviendo la adopción de estándares de desarrollo y buenas prácticas.

Analizarás y mejorarás la velocidad, eficiencia y capacidad de respuesta de las aplicaciones, asegurando una experiencia de usuario óptima.

Trabajarás estrechamente con equipos de producto, diseño, infraestructura y otros departamentos, participando activamente en ceremonias ágiles (sprint planning, dailies, retros, etc.) para garantizar el éxito del proyecto.

Investigarás, evaluarás e implementarás tecnologías emergentes que puedan aportar valor al equipo o a los proyectos.

Timing de primeras semanas en OGA

Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.

¿Qué requerimos?

Titulación de Grado en Ingeniería del Software, alternativamente, Grado Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web o Aplicaciones Multiplataforma.

Conocimientos en API REST, Docker, Plataforma Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP y Pruebas unitarias.

Experiencia mínima profesional de 5 años en Desarrollo con framework Microsoft .NET 6, ASP.NET Core 3.1 o superior, en Angular v14, en Desarrollo JavaScript ES6+, HTML 5 y CSS 3, en Patrones de diseño: DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS y en Lenguaje SQL y diseño de base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

¿Qué valoramos?

Conocimientos en UI/UX.

Uso de herramientas de testing: Postman o Selenium.

Conocimientos de CI & CD.

Conocimientos de Kubernetes.

Conocimientos de Arquitectura de microservicios.

Conocimientos de Python.

Trabajo en equipo en marcos de trabajo Agile y uso de herramientas de gestión

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.

Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.

Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.

Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.

Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.

Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.

Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.

Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.

Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.

Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.

¡Únete a nosotros!

Si te entusiasma nuestra visión innovadora y estás listo/a para enfrentar desafíos diarios con empresas líderes, ¡queremos conocerte! Aplica ahora y únete a OGA para seguir creando soluciones increíbles y de gran impacto.

Por supuesto, si durante el proceso de selección necesitaras algún tipo de asistencia, simplemente avísanos. Nuestro equipo de People te ayudará para asegurarnos de que todo vaya sobre ruedas y tengas una experiencia genial.

¡Te esperamos!

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
to join the Data and AI Transformation Engineering team, responsible for designing and building scalable backend platforms that expose AI and automation capabilities as reliable, production grade services.

The role focuses on developing API driven systems deployed on Kubernetes, combining AI driven components with deterministic logic to support complex transformation and automation use cases across multiple business units. Operating in a regulated financial services environment, the role requires a strong engineering mindset with compliance, governance, and responsible use of AI treated as core design principles.

What You Do

Design and maintain RESTful APIs with robust versioning strategies, ensuring stability as model behaviour evolves across releases.
Define structured, validated response schemas that deliver deterministic, auditable outputs suitable for enterprise consumption.
Implement streaming response patterns (SSE / chunked HTTP) to enable real-time model output delivery to frontends and downstream systems.
Implement authentication and authorisation frameworks (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, scopes) including service principal patterns for cloud-to-cloud integration across Azure, AWS, and Databricks.
Enforce data controls at the API layer — including input sanitisation, output filtering, and guardrails — ensuring responses meet compliance standards before leaving the system.
Build audit logging into the API contract so that every request and response is fully traceable for regulatory purposes.
Design background job patterns that return immediately to callers while model inference executes asynchronously.
Integrate with message queues and event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, SQS, Kafka) for pipeline orchestration.
Implement polling and webhook callback mechanisms to deliver results without blocking consumers.
Establish structured logging on every API call — capturing inputs, outputs, latency, and model version metadata.
Integrate with enterprise monitoring platforms (Datadog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch) to ensure full-stack visibility.
Implement drift detection hooks that flag when model outputs deviate from expected patterns.
Manage versioned model endpoints, enabling seamless deployment of new model versions without breaking existing API consumers.
Develop automated testing strategies for non-deterministic outputs, including contract tests, output validation, and regression benchmarks.
Deploy containerised APIs on Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) with health checks, autoscaling, and production-grade reliability.
Wrap managed AI services (Databricks Model Serving, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) behind clean, internal API contracts.

What You Bring

University degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of experience in backend engineering with Python, with a proven track record of delivering AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic systems into enterprise production environments (beyond prototypes or proofs of concept).
Hands on experience with cloud based AI services across Azure and AWS, including strong expertise in Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake, Model Serving).
Strong background in designing clean, versioned APIs and building distributed systems, including asynchronous patterns, background processing, and message based architectures.
Proven experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes, managing infrastructure using Terraform, and treating observability, structured logging, and monitoring as standard engineering practices.
Experience working in regulated environments, where auditability, data controls, security, and compliance are core engineering requirements.
Demonstrated ownership mindset: able to take systems from design through production and incident resolution, collaborate across business units, and create reusable platform patterns that enable other teams.
Good level of English (required), other languages (e.g. Spanish or additional European languages) are nice to have.
We highly welcome candidates with a genuine interest and affinity for Information Technology (IT) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), as these attributes are considered valuable assets to our team.

What We Offer

We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered .
Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the center of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural Internal background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

jobs.title: Senior Support Analyst (API & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

OneTrust is looking for a Senior Support Analyst to join the CORE Platform Support team in Madrid. In this role, you will own complex technical support cases involving integrations, authentication, APIs, messaging, and platform-level functionality.

You will act as a trusted technical partner to customers and an escalation point for Support Analysts. You will investigate difficult issues, communicate clearly with customers, collaborate with Product and Engineering, and help strengthen the team’s technical capability through knowledge sharing and mentoring.

The CORE team supports customers across areas including Single Sign-On, SMTP, APIs, Data Discovery, Certification Automation integrations, tenant-wide performance issues, integration workflows, and integration requests.

Your Mission

Own and resolve complex CORE support cases escalated from Support Analysts, taking responsibility from initial investigation through resolution or an effective engineering handoff.
Troubleshoot advanced issues across SSO, SAML, SMTP, APIs, integrations, workflows, Data Discovery, and related platform capabilities.
Reproduce customer issues in appropriate test or support environments and use available evidence to identify probable causes and practical resolutions.
Analyse logs, trace information, configuration details, API requests, integration behaviour, and other technical evidence to isolate issues.
Provide clear, structured customer communication, including acknowledgement, investigation updates, action plans, and resolution explanations.
Determine when an issue requires escalation to Product or Engineering and raise high-quality Jira tickets with the relevant troubleshooting, evidence, impact, and technical questions.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Incident Management, and other Support teams to drive complex issues to resolution.
Identify recurring issues, documentation gaps, workflow improvements, and opportunities to reduce repeat contacts and escalations.
Mentor and support other analysts through case reviews, technical guidance, troubleshooting walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Contribute to onboarding and enablement for new analysts joining the CORE team.
Maintain strong case ownership, accurate documentation, timely updates, and adherence to support processes and service-level expectations.
Continue building expertise through product releases, technical training, office hours, hands-on investigation, and relevant certifications.

You Are

Experience in a technical customer support, technical account support, SaaS support, application support, or similar role.
Demonstrated experience handling complex technical issues and escalations in a customer-facing environment.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work methodically from symptoms and evidence to a clear diagnosis.
Experience supporting integrations involving identity providers, APIs, data connectors, or workflow automation.
Practical understanding of several of the following areas:
SSO, SAML, identity providers, certificates, and authentication flows
SMTP, email delivery, connection testing, and email-related troubleshooting
Kubernetes
REST APIs, authentication, request/response analysis, and tools such as Postman
SaaS integrations, workflows, web technologies, and system dependencies

Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working with ticketing and engineering collaboration tools, such as Salesforce and Jira.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview .
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us as a Sr. Software Engineer on the R&D Software Team and own real software from the ground up — not a ticket queue. You'll shape the roadmap, make the technical calls, and build the real-time data platform that turns industrial IoT telemetry into decisions our customers can act on.

Where You'll Work: This is a remote-friendly role — most of your work in practice can be done remotely, with occasional in-person collaboration at our Porto office. Our engineers tell us that flexibility is one of the things they value most about working here.

Job Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to the Digital Integration Director, you will own software solutions end to end, from framing the business problem to running services reliably in production, built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors monitoring liquid and gas storage tanks across industries including industrial chemical, industrial gas, propane, and other fuels. Collaborate for success

Own projects end to end, starting from a greenfield state: define your own requirements, shape the roadmap, and take solutions through to production.
Work cross-functionally with teams like Sales and Marketing, translating business goals into working software.
Make the technical decisions and contribute significantly to the implementation — this is a hands-on role, not a hand-off-to-others one.

Build data-driven systems

Build and operate the backend services and APIs behind a platform ingesting real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors at sites across the globe.
Design and run the data pipelines that turn that telemetry into something people can act on — including forecasting and anomaly detection on time series.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, irregular sampling, and a device population that keeps evolving. Bring the statistical judgment to tell a real signal from noise, and to say how confident we should be.
Run what you build — instrumentation, alerting, and the operational habits that keep a system healthy.

Engineer with AI assistance

Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests, and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any system whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.

Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across software engineering, data engineering, and platform operations, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

What Success Looks Like

Backend services and data pipelines for real-time IoT telemetry run reliably in production, with strong instrumentation and alerting in place.
Forecasting and anomaly detection outputs are trustworthy enough that customers and internal stakeholders act on them with confidence.
Engineering practices — code review, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development — visibly raise the team's baseline, not just this person's own output.
Other engineers are actively mentored and leveled up through code review and design discussion.
Business stakeholders trust this person to translate technical trade-offs and uncertainty into decisions they can act on.

What you'll need to succeed: Minimum Requirements -

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or scientific field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years in software engineering or a closely related role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred). A completed PhD in a quantitative or scientific discipline, with substantial hands-on programming, counts toward this.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests, and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong analytical ability and working fluency with statistics: distributions, uncertainty, correlation and causation, and knowing when a result is real.
Solid SQL and experience working with data at scale — pandas, PySpark, and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Postgres.
Experience operating software in production: deployment, monitoring, alerting, and a feel for the practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications -

Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, streaming pipelines.
Time series work in production: forecasting, anomaly detection, or similar.
Experience with message queuing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production — building them, not just calling them.
Hands-on with an agent framework: LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MetaGPT, or similar. We care that you have shipped one, not which one.
Familiarity with the interoperability protocols — MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent2Agent) — for exposing systems as tools other agents can call directly, and for getting agents to talk to each other.
Experience with Microsoft Foundry for building, evaluating, and deploying agents.
Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT settings.

About Anova

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

new_jobs.title: Junior Research Software Engineer for Sustainability Science - Full Stack- NL
new_jobs.description:
The Institute of Environmental Science CML at Leiden University is looking for a motivated Junior Research Software Engineer (RSE) with experience in full-stack development, data visualization, and modern software engineering practices to turn scientific insights into reliable and user-friendly software. In this role, you will help design, build, and maintain the next generation of industrial ecology research tools that support sustainability, circular economy analysis and decision making, as well as reproducible science across the institute. You will work closely with researchers to help create dashboards, APIs, and visual analytics that communicate scientific results to academic users, policymakers, and the wider public. Your contributions will directly empower transparent, open, and reproducible research within for sustainability decision making.

What You Will Do

In your role, you will work closely with a Senior Research Software Engineers, Principal Investigators and PhDs to strengthen the scientific software engineering basis of our institute. Specifically, you will be responsible for tasks such as:

Building and maintaining scientific software, web applications and dashboards for research dissemination and policy communication (e.g., WISE database, Activity Browser, Panorama web-app, ReLab)
Supporting the development and maintenance of data pipelines and reproducible workflows for environmental databases and analytics.
Collaborating with researchers to scope features, translate research needs into user-friendly tools, and ensure usability and accessibility.
Supporting deployment in cloud and/or open environments (e.g., containerized services), working with the senior RSE on infrastructure alignment.
Promoting good data and software management for FAIR and open science practices, version control (Git/GitHub), testing (pytest), packaging, documentation, etc.

Where you will work

Leiden University is situated between Amsterdam (36 km) and The Hague (15 km) and was founded in 1575, making it the oldest university in the Netherlands. It houses around 35,000 students originating from 112 nationalities, facilitated by approximately 8,000 staff.

The Institute of Environmental Science (CML) at Leiden University offers a vibrant and supportive community of scientists committed to the challenges of sustainability. CML distinguishes itself for its attention to professional development in coordination with the interests of its scientists. As such, there are plenty of opportunities to learn new skills, expand your knowledge, collaborate across disciplines, and experiment in a friendly environment fully embodying academic freedom across all career levels.

The core focus of CML is to perform research and education in the interdisciplinary field of Environmental Sciences. CML focuses on the sustainable use of natural resources and preservation of natural capital and biodiversity. CML has a culture of mutual support and collaboration between researchers. CML has two Departments: Industrial Ecology (CML-IE) and Environmental Biology (CML-EB). Presently, about 150 fte (including postdocs and PhDs) are employed at CML. CML further collaborates with TU Delft and Erasmus University in the Leiden-Delft-Erasmus Centre for Sustainability (LDE-CfS), and with the Naturalis Biodiversity Centre.

The Institute of Environmental Sciences (CML) is positioned in the Faculty of Sciences. The Faculty of Science is a world-class faculty where staff and students work together in a dynamic international environment. It is a faculty where personal and academic development are top priorities. Our people are committed to expanding fundamental knowledge by curiosity and looking beyond the borders of their own discipline; their aim is to benefit science and to make a contribution to addressing the major societal challenges of the future. The research carried out at the Faculty of Science is very diverse, ranging from mathematics, information science, astronomy, physics, chemistry and bio-pharmaceutical sciences to biology and environmental sciences. The research activities are organized in eight institutes. These institutes offer eight bachelor’s and twelve master’s programmes. The faculty has grown strongly in recent years and now has more than 2.800 staff and almost 6000 students. We are located at the heart of Leiden’s Bio Science Park, one of Europe’s biggest science parks, where university and business life come together.

For more information, see www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/science. Information about CML can be found at www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/science/environmental-sciences.

What You Bring

MSc in computer science, data science, AI, environmental informatics, or related field.
Good programming skills with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. Other programming languages are a plus.
Experience with front‑end frameworks (e.g., React) and data visualization (e.g., D3/Plotly).
Experience building back‑end APIs (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask) and integrating databases (SQL/NoSQL).
Experience contributing to open‑source projects.
Familiarity with containerization (e.g., Docker) and reproducibility tools
Excellent collaboration skills, a service mindset, and enthusiasm for environmental applications and open science

What We Offer

We offer an initial one-year contract, with an option to extend to a permanent contract based on performance, following the pay scale 9 in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch Universities. Salary ranges from € 3.708 to € 5.057 gross per month based on a full-time position .

At our institution, we believe in flexibility and work-life balance! With a full-time position (38 hours per week), you are entitled to 232 vacation hours per year
, which is equivalent to 30.5 vacation days
(based on a 38-hour work week). If you value flexibility, you have the freedom to adjust your working hours. For example, you could choose to work 40 hours per week, earning extra compensation hours. Alternatively, if you prefer a shorter work week, you can work 36 hours per week by using some of your vacation days to create more time for yourself. You’ll work closely with your supervisor to tailor your schedule in a way that suits both your needs and the team’s.

In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

Holiday allowance (8%) and an end-of-year bonus (8.3%)
An attractive pension scheme with ABP, ensuring your financial well-being both now and in the future
Extensive options for secondary employment conditions: You can explore options such as sabbaticals, paid parental leave, and the individual choices model, which allows you to exchange leave days and/or salary for benefits like an advantageous sports subscription, bicycle scheme, and childcare options
Hybrid working options: If your role allows, you can enjoy the flexibility of working from home within the Netherlands
Home-working allowance: You’ll receive a home-working allowance (for both workdays and internet), and the university will provide you with a laptop and support for creating a comfortable home office

We are committed to offering a flexible, supportive, and rewarding work environment, designed to help you grow both professionally and personally. For more information about the working conditions, please visit: https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/working-at/job-application-procedure-and-employment-conditions

What We Value

At the Faculty of Science, we value inclusiveness and strive for a diverse community with equal opportunities for all. We give full support to our staff in achieving their potential to become independent academic researchers and teachers. For more information about our policy on diversity and equality please go to the diversity page on our website: https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/dossiers/diversity

Female researchers are also welcome to join the Researchers In Science for Equality network of the Faculty of Science (rise.nu).

Want to apply or find out more?

new_jobs.description:
NotarNow zählt zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Scale-ups Deutschlands – vollständig bootstrapped und ohne Venture Capital. Unser Legal AI Workspace wird bereits von über 1.500 Juristinnen und Juristen sowie mehr als 6.000 Mitarbeitenden täglich genutzt – darunter viele der renommiertesten Notariate und Kanzleien Deutschlands.

In zweieinhalb Jahren sind wir von 2 auf 15 Teammitglieder gewachsen und haben über 3 Mio. Euro ARR. Jetzt skalieren wir in Richtung 6–8 Mio. Euro ARR innerhalb der nächsten 12 Monate und bauen unser Produktportfolio weiter aus.

Du arbeitest remote oder in unserem neu gebauten Büro in der Mozartstraße 4 direkt an der Theresienwiese in München – mit neuestem Equipment, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und der Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit NotarNow zu wachsen.

Deine Rolle

Unsere Produkte laufen vollständig in der Cloud – mit einem Next.js-/TypeScript-Frontend und einem FastAPI-Backend auf AWS. Unsere Kunden arbeiten gleichzeitig mit lokalen Windows-Anwendungen, Kanzleisoftware, Druckern, Ordnerstrukturen und Schnittstellen, die nie für moderne Cloud-Software gebaut wurden.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Als Windows / Desktop Software Engineer (m/w/d)
baust Du die technische Brücke zwischen unserer Cloud und der lokalen Windows-Umgebung unserer Kunden. Unser heutiger Desktop-Client besteht aus rund 45.000 Zeilen AutoHotkey und läuft produktiv bei unseren Kunden. Jetzt entwickeln wir ihn zu einer modularen, skalierbaren und langfristig wartbaren Windows-Plattform weiter. Welche Architektur und Technologien dafür langfristig die richtigen sind, gestaltest Du maßgeblich mit.

Was Du konkret tust

Du verantwortest KI:RSTEN Desktop technisch end-to-end – Architektur, Entwicklung, Tests, Releases und produktiven Betrieb.
Du modernisierst unsere bestehende AutoHotkey-Anwendung schrittweise, ohne den laufenden Betrieb unserer Kunden zu gefährden.
Du baust und betreibst Integrationen zu mehr als zehn lokalen Kanzlei- und Notariatsprogrammen und synchronisierst Kontakte, Dokumente und Vorgangsdaten zwischen Cloud, Browser, Desktop und On-Premise-Systemen.
Du integrierst REST-/HTTP-APIs, lokale APIs, Dateisysteme, Netzlaufwerke und Importverzeichnisse und entwickelst robuste Mechanismen für Authentifizierung, Fehlerbehandlung, Retries, Timeouts und Synchronisation.
Du entwickelst lokale Services und Background-Prozesse und sorgst dafür, dass Datei- und Dokumentenverarbeitung auch bei parallelen Zugriffen, Fehlern und Wiederanläufen zuverlässig funktioniert.
Du entwickelst UI- und Prozessautomatisierungen weiter – und erkennst, wann aus einer schnellen Automatisierung eine native, langfristig wartbare Integration werden sollte.
Du baust professionelle Installer und Deployment-Prozesse inklusive Updates, Code Signing, Upgrade-Pfaden, Deinstallation und Rollback.
Du stellst durch Logging, Tests, automatisierte Builds und reproduzierbare Releases sicher, dass unsere Software auch auf unterschiedlich konfigurierten Windows-Systemen zuverlässig läuft.
Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden, Schnittstellenpartnern und externen Entwicklerteams zusammen und begleitest neue Integrationen von der technischen Abstimmung bis zum produktiven Rollout.

Mit wem Du arbeitest

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklerteam und insbesondere mit Moritz zusammen. Er ist Notar-Fachreferent und Softwareentwickler und kennt die Prozesse, Kanzleisoftwares und lokalen Integrationen unserer Kunden im Detail. Du bringst die tiefe Windows-/Desktop-Engineering-Erfahrung mit; gemeinsam entwickelt Ihr aus bestehenden Automatisierungen und Integrationen eine professionelle Plattform.

Dabei arbeitest Du regelmäßig direkt mit Kunden, der Bundesnotarkammer und Entwicklern führender On-Premise-Softwareanbieter. Mal spezifiziert Ihr gemeinsam eine API, mal analysierst Du eine historisch gewachsene lokale Schnittstelle oder einen Prozess, der auf einem Kundenrechner anders läuft als erwartet.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn Du

mehrjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Windows- oder Desktop-Entwicklung hast und Software vom Code bis zum produktiven Betrieb verantworten kannst.
Erfahrung mit C#/.NET und WPF, WinUI oder vergleichbaren Technologien mitbringst. Unser Client ist heute AutoHotkey – wohin sich die Plattform technologisch entwickelt, entscheidest Du mit.
bereits gewachsene Anwendungen schrittweise modernisiert hast, statt nur auf der grünen Wiese zu entwickeln.
sicher mit REST/HTTP, Authentifizierung, OAuth, Zertifikaten und der Kommunikation zwischen lokalen Clients und Cloud-Systemen umgehen kannst.
Windows Services, Background-Prozesse und das Windows-Berechtigungsmodell verstehst – etwa Benutzerrechte, UAC, NTFS-/Freigaberechte sowie AppData und ProgramData.
Erfahrung mit Windows-Installern, Updates, Code Signing, Upgrade-Pfaden und Rollbacks hast.
Dich gerne tief in fremde Systeme, schlecht dokumentierte Schnittstellen und ungewöhnliche technische Umgebungen einarbeitest.
technische Probleme eigenständig bis zu einer stabilen produktiven Lösung treibst und auch direkt mit Kunden und Partnern kommunizieren kannst.
sehr gut Deutsch
und gut Englisch sprichst.

Besonders spannend finden wir

Windows-Infrastruktur: Terminalserver/RDS, Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien, Registry, PowerShell, Dienstkonten und Credential Manager.
AutoHotkey, Power Automate sowie UI- und Prozessautomatisierung unter Windows.
Robuste Integrationen: Idempotenz, Retry-/Timeout-Strategien, Queues, Locks, konkurrierende Dateizugriffe und Wiederanlauf nach Fehlern.
Microsoft-Ökosystem: Outlook, Exchange, Microsoft Graph, COM-/Office-Integrationen und Windows Printing APIs.
IPC und lokale Kommunikation: Named Pipes, localhost-APIs und vergleichbare Mechanismen.
Lokale Datenhaltung und Synchronisation, etwa SQLite, Offline-/Cache-Konzepte und Dokumenten-Workflows.
Enterprise- oder Legal-Tech-Software mit heterogenen lokalen Installationen, Softwareständen und administrierten Windows-Umgebungen.
AWS/S3, Git-basierte Delivery, automatisierte Builds, Tests und Release-Pipelines.
Legal Tech: Erfahrung z.B. mit RA-MICRO, DATEV, Advoware, TriNotar.

AutoHotkey oder Power Automate müssen nicht Deine Hauptwerkzeuge sein. Entscheidend ist, dass Du verstehst, wann Automatisierung sinnvoll ist – und wann sie durch eine saubere Softwareintegration ersetzt werden sollte.

Wie wir arbeiten

Hohe Ownership: Du lieferst Ergebnisse, nicht Tickets.
Wenig Hierarchie und kurze Entscheidungswege: technische Entscheidungen werden dort getroffen, wo das Wissen sitzt.
Schnell, aber mit Qualitätsanspruch: robuste Fehlerbehandlung, Tests, Logging und nachvollziehbare Architektur gehören zum Produkt.
Direkter Kontakt zu Kunden und Partnern ist Teil der Rolle – Produktverständnis ist genauso wichtig wie guter Code.
AI-Tools gehören für uns selbstverständlich zum Entwicklungsalltag. Entscheidend ist, dass Du verstehst, testest und verantwortest, was Du auslieferst.

Was wir Dir bieten

Sehr viel Ownership über einen strategisch wichtigen Produktbereich.
Großen Gestaltungsspielraum bei Architektur, Technologien und der nächsten Generation von KI:RSTEN Desktop.
Technische Herausforderungen deutlich jenseits klassischer Web- oder CRUD-Entwicklung.
Direkten Austausch mit Kunden, der Bundesnotarkammer und führenden Softwareanbietern.
Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkten Zugang zu Development, Product und Geschäftsleitung.
Attraktives Gehaltspaket und Top-IT-Equipment nach Wahl.
EGYM Wellpass.
Remote oder vor Ort: Modernes Büro direkt an der Theresienwiese in München; die Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder vollständig remote ausgeübt werden.

Deine ersten 30 / 60 / 90 Tage

30 Tage:
Du verstehst unsere Desktop-Architektur, die AutoHotkey-Codebase, die wichtigsten Integrationen und den Datenfluss zwischen Cloud und lokalen Systemen – und hast erste Änderungen produktiv ausgeliefert.
60 Tage:
Du übernimmst eigenständig eine größere Integration oder ein Desktop-Feature und verbesserst einen zentralen Bereich wie Synchronisation, Installer, Updates, Logging oder Prozessautomatisierung.
90 Tage:
Du verantwortest einen größeren Teil von KI:RSTEN Desktop technisch, hast die weitere Architektur mitgeprägt und setzt neue Integrationen von der ersten technischen Entscheidung bis zum produktiven Rollout eigenständig um.

Start: ab sofort.

Bewerbung per E-Mail an karriere@notarnow.de – gerne mit Link zu Deinem GitHub-Profil.

new_jobs.description:
Department:
Technology
Location:
London

Description

Defaqto is one of the most trusted names in UK financial services research and ratings, and our technology turns deep market data into decisions that advisers, providers and consumers rely on every day. The credibility of that output rests on the quality of our engineering.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to be the most senior individual contributor in our Technology function. Reporting to the Head of Engineering and working closely with the CTO, you will own how we build software at Defaqto: our engineering standards and practices, our technical direction, and above all the shift from AI-assisted coding towards AI-led delivery, with engineers directing and verifying rather than typing.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role without the requirement of management, unless you are keen to do so. You will guide several squads, earning influence through judgement, craft and delivered outcomes. You will also take direct technical ownership of the initiatives that carry the most technical risk or the most upside at any given time. Our current focus is opening Defaqto data to developers and AI agents through well-governed APIs and MCP servers, but the role is defined by the level you operate at, not by any one product — expect what you own to change as our priorities do.

You will also be a genuine sounding board for technology leadership, as comfortable shaping a multi-year technical strategy as unblocking a production problem this afternoon. If you are the engineer other engineers go to when a decision really matters, and you want the remit to raise the bar across a whole organisation rather than a single team, this is that role.

What you'll do

Lead our shift from AI-assisted coding to AI-led delivery
Own the trajectory: take us from engineers using assistants to help write code, to engineers directing agents that write it — with the human firmly in the loop as architect, reviewer and accountable owner rather than as the typist.
Define what good looks like at each step of that shift: context and prompt engineering, agent-readable codebases (clear structure, strong typing, rich tests, machine-readable specs and repository guidance), and tooling that makes agent output reproducible rather than lucky.
Make the review layer the new craft. Raise our standards for reading, verifying and hardening generated code: tests as the contract, static analysis and security scanning inside the loop, and no unreviewed AI-authored change reaching production.
Rebuild our practices around specification over syntax, so engineers spend their time on problem framing, acceptance criteria, architecture and verification instead of on implementation keystrokes.
Run structured experiments with new models, agents and workflows. Measure lead time, change failure rate, review burden and developer experience, and retire anything that does not earn its place.
Set the guardrails that make this safe in a regulated business: secure and licence-aware tooling, provenance and auditability for generated code, client and personal data kept inside approved boundaries, and a named human accountable for everything that ships.
Take the organisation with you. Coach engineers through the identity shift from writing code to engineering outcomes, and make the sceptics as fluent as the enthusiasts.

Turn developer practices into engineering practices
Move us beyond individual developer habits to engineering discipline that holds at organisational scale — and at the change volume that agentic delivery produces.
Codify practice into the paved road: templates, scaffolds, pipelines, linters, policy-as-code, automated checks and agent instructions, so the right thing is the easy thing for humans and agents alike.
Define, document and continuously evolve the engineering standards that apply across Defaqto Technology — code review, testing, branching, observability, security by design, documentation and definition of done.
Hold the line on quality in a way teams welcome: coaching, pairing and reviewing rather than policing. Be our evangelist for software craftsmanship, and help raise the hiring bar to match it.

Take hands-on technical ownership of the problems that matter most
Own the initiatives that carry the most technical risk or the most upside, end to end — architecture, build, launch and the operational reality afterwards. What that is will change as our priorities do; the level at which you operate will not.
Design platforms and integration surfaces for both the consumers we have and the ones we are gaining: human developers and AI agents. Machine-readable capability discovery, unambiguous tool definitions, MCP servers and other agent-facing interfaces where they fit, semantics an agent can reason over, predictable errors, idempotency, and rate limiting that behaves sensibly under agentic access patterns.
Build data governance into the technology rather than into a policy handbook: entitlements and licensing enforced at the point of access, per-consumer scoping, lineage and provenance carried with the data, and full audit of which human or agent accessed what, and when.
Make quality and trust observable — data contracts, freshness and quality signals exposed to consumers, and semantics clear enough that a consumer cannot silently misread a rating or a field.
Care about the consumption experience end to end: self-service onboarding, keys and sandboxes, SDKs, documentation as a product, usage analytics, versioning and deprecation. Treat time to first successful call, by a person or an agent, as a metric you own.

Partner with Product to add technology value
Act as the technical validation point for product ideas, pressure-testing feasibility, cost, risk and sequencing early, before commitments are made.
Bring technology-led opportunities to the table: things our data, platform and AI capability make possible that Product had not thought to ask for.
Translate between commercial intent and technical reality in both directions, without diluting either.

Guide squads and evolve the tech stack
Guide multiple teams within your squad towards sound, well-supported technology choices, and away from novelty for its own sake.
Own continuous improvement of the tech stack with clear, valued outcomes: every material change carries a stated benefit, a measure and a migration plan.
Lead the architecture decisions that cross team boundaries, document them as ADRs, and keep our technical debt position honest and visible.

Be a strategic and tactical sounding board
Act as trusted counsel to the Head of Engineering, the CTO and the wider leadership team on both long-range strategy and this week’s trade-offs.
Represent engineering reality in commercial, regulatory and roadmap conversations.
Stay hands-on — build, review and verify on the work that matters most.

What you'll need to succeed:

Essential requirements:
Substantial commercial software engineering experience, including time at staff, principal or equivalent level, with a track record of technical influence well beyond your own team.
Deep, current, hands-on engineering ability in a modern stack, with the breadth to stay credible outside your strongest language. Our core stack is a mix of .NET / C# and TypeScript on Azure, Python and PHP, with SQL and modern data tooling.
Real, evidenced experience leading agentic and AI-assisted development in a production engineering organisation — not just personal use of an assistant. You can show how you changed a team’s practices, what you measured, and how you kept quality and accountability intact.
A clear point of view on the engineering practices that make AI-led delivery work: specification and context engineering, test-first contracts, agent-readable codebases, and review as a first-class discipline.
Demonstrable ownership of engineering standards and practices across multiple teams: you have written them, embedded them in tooling, and actually changed behaviour with them.
Strong API and integration engineering: designing, versioning, securing and operating interfaces consumed by other people’s systems — and increasingly by their agents — with real care for the consumer experience around them.
Treats data governance as an engineering problem: entitlements, licensing, lineage, provenance and auditability enforced in the technology rather than asserted in a policy document.
Sound distributed systems and cloud architecture judgement — resilience, observability, performance, cost and operability, not just diagrams.
Excellent influencing and communication skills: you build consensus across teams and can hold your own with product, commercial and executive audiences.
Commercial instinct — you tie technical work to outcomes the business recognises and can measure.
A mentoring track record: senior engineers have become materially better because they worked with you.
Comfort with a moving remit. You are motivated by owning whichever problem is hardest right now, not by owning one system indefinitely.

Desirable requirements:
Experience building or operating agent-facing integration surfaces — MCP servers, tool-calling interfaces or similar.
Financial services, fintech or regulated data experience, and comfort treating FCA and UK GDPR / ICO expectations as design constraints rather than afterthoughts.
Experience with data products, business intelligence or analytics platforms — data modelling, contracts, quality, lineage and entitlements.
Experience of a developer portal, API marketplace or platform-as-a-product.
Platform engineering and developer experience work: CI/CD, internal developer platforms, golden paths, policy-as-code and self-service tooling.
Event-driven architecture, and experience of legacy modernisation or migration programmes.
Contribution to the wider engineering community — open source, writing, speaking or standards work.

Your approach to work:
Pragmatic. You optimise for outcomes and maintainability, not for elegance or novelty.
Generous. You make other engineers better, and you take real pleasure in it.
Evidence-led. You hold strong opinions loosely and change your mind when the data says so.
Direct and kind. You disagree well, in the open, and commit fully once a decision is made.
Curious and current. You keep learning fast in a field that is moving fast, and you bring what you learn back to the organisation.
Steady under pressure. You are the calm one when something is on fire.

Important to know:

Location:
Hybrid — London or Haddenham office, with the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. You will spend regular time on site with your squads and with product and leadership colleagues.

Right to Work:

Applicants must already hold a legal right to work in the UK without time restrictions and without the need for future sponsorship. We are unable to provide Skilled Worker visa sponsorship.

To act as a senior technical lead for the design, development and delivery of solutions on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM and Power Platform within the Innovation & Technology (I&T) team. What You'll Be Doing as a Data Architect:

Advocate the business benefit of data standards, championing and governing those standards across projects and the organisation
