Lead complex data migration projects from legacy systems to modern cloud-native platforms
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies across the modern data stack to meet specific client needs
Mentor junior team members and collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders

Your Impact:

Enable transformative business decisions through robust, scalable data architectures
Drive adoption of modern data platforms and AI-enabled analytics solutions
Establish technical standards and architectural patterns that ensure quality, security, and maintainability
Help cultivate a data-driven culture within client organisations and internally
Deliver architectures that seamlessly integrate traditional and modern data systems

Requirements

You Will Demonstrate:

Deep knowledge of the Azure data stack (Azure SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Data Factory, Purview, Synapse, Event Hub, Azure Databricks/Fabric)
Extensive data modelling experience: both normalised relational models and de-normalised Star Schema/dimensional models
Excellent relational database design skills with expertise in diagnosing and optimising performance across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud databases

Understanding of vector databases and similarity search for AI applications

Industry specialisation in specific sectors (Engineering, Manufacturing, Healthcare etc.)

Basware is a global leader in cloud-based purchase-to-pay and e-invoicing solutions, processing billions of transactions annually for enterprise customers across 100+ countries. With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

Define the approach for integrating AI capabilities into core product flows — from document intelligence to autonomous process automation

,

new_jobs.description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

Vil du være med til at skabe fremtidens IT-løsninger og arbejde i en virksomhed, hvor din udvikling og trivsel er i fokus? Hvis ja, er du måske vores nye Senior eller Lead .Net Udvikler til vores Code team. Her får du chancen for at spille en central rolle i den fortsatte opbygning af en fremadstormende konsulentvirksomhed.

Hvem er Sopra Steria?

Sopra Steria er en IT-konsulentforretning med fokus på softwareudvikling, projektledelse og data/analyse. Vi hjælper i dag særligt finansielle institutioner og den offentlige sektor med at nå deres ambitioner. Vi kombinerer moderne teknologi og en solid forretningsforståelse for at sikre, at vi finder løsninger, som både er attraktive, værdiskabende og er teknisk mulige at gennemføre samt implementere. Vi er med fra start til slut.

Siden 2015 har vi været i top-10 som ”Danmarks bedste it-virksomhed” i ”Great Place To Works” årlige undersøgelse, og vi er i høj grad drevet af at skabe et godt, socialt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på resultater og det gode arbejdsliv i balance. Det er fundamentalt for os, at vores medarbejdere har det godt, og syntes at det er sjovt at gå på arbejde, det er sådan vi skaber de bedste resultater.

Hvad skal du lave?

Som senior .NET udvikler vil du have en central rolle i at lede og rådgive vores kunder i komplekse IT-projekter. Din ekspertise inden for Microsoft-teknologier og produkter er afgørende for at sikre, at vores løsninger ikke blot imødekommer, men også overstiger kundernes forventninger. Du bliver en nøglespiller i at oversætte kundens forretningsbehov til tekniske løsninger samtidig med, at du sikrer, at alle interessenter er involveret og informeret gennem klar og effektiv kommunikation.

Du vil ikke blot udvikle software, men også være ansvarlig for at definere opgaver og estimere projektomfang. Din evne til at navigere i komplekse forretningsprocesser og arbejdsgange vil være afgørende for at sikre, at vores løsninger integreres problemfrit i kundens miljø.

Vi værdsætter din evne til at forudsige og imødekomme ændringer hos vores kunder og forventer, at du tager ansvar for at sikre, at alle projekter bliver en succes. Du vil dagligt arbejde tæt sammen med kunder enten på deres lokation, hjemmefra eller fra vores kontor i centrum af København. Her bliver du en del af et dynamisk team af passionerede kollegaer med rig mulighed for at udvikle dine færdigheder.

Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren og initiativrig konsulent, der trives med at være dybt involveret i kundens forretning. Du ser det som din fornemmeste opgave at udfordre status quo for at sikre de mest optimale løsninger. Som holdspiller bidrager du aktivt til et inspirerende fagligt fællesskab og stræber efter konstant at udvikle dine kompetencer. Din selvstændighed og evne til at navigere i udfordrende situationer gør dig særligt velegnet i et miljø, hvor rammerne løbende formes, og hvor du aktivt medvirker til at definere din egen rolle.

Vi værdsætter dine personlige egenskaber højt, især din evne til at arbejde tæt sammen med kunderne og være opsøgende og proaktiv i din tilgang. Som engageret og nysgerrig udvikler er du drevet af at løse problemer og udforske nye muligheder.

Vi ser gerne at du...

Har solid erfaring med C# og .NET,
Mestre traditionel web udvikling (ASP.NET and MVC),
API integrationer, REST,
Databaser teknologier som SQL, NoSQL, Entity Framework,
Er flydende i dansk, både skriftlig og mundtlig.
Erfaring fra konsulenthus.

Det er herudover en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med...

Frontend frameworks som Angular, React, Vue.js eller .NET Blazor,
Cloud platforme som AWS, Azure eller GCP (Google),
DevOps, CD/CI,
Agil udvikling, Scrum eller tilsvarende.
Erfaring fra projekter i den finansielle eller offentlige sektor.

Bliv en del af os

Her får du altså muligheden for at blive en del af en organisation i rivende udvikling, som er kendt for at skabe stærke relationer både internt og med vores kunder. Og sidst men ikke mindst bliver du en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor videndeling og sparring er i højsædet.

Vi tilbyder:

Søde og passionerede kollegaer, som glæder sig til at arbejde sammen med dig.
En uformel og sjov hverdag på en spændende arbejdsplads med sociale og hjælpsomme kolleger.
Gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling: seminarer, konferencer, coaching, sparring, certificeringer mv.
Regelmæssige sociale arrangementer som fredagsbar, onsdagstræning, sommerfest etc.
Fleksibel arbejdsplads med mulighed for at arbejde fra vores kontor i København i kombination med hjemmearbejdsdage.

Er du klar til at tage det næste skridt i din karriere og blive en del af Sopra Steria? Send os dit CV og eventuelt en motiveret ansøgning allerede i dag, så vi kan starte dialogen om, hvordan vi kan skabe værdi sammen.

Vi ser frem til at læse dit CV!

Yderligere oplysninger

Vi er en af nordens førende konsulentvirksomheder inden for digitalisering, innovation og moderne teknologi og gennem mange år har vi været rangeret som en af Danmarks bedste IT-arbejdspladser.

Som en af nordens største konsulentvirksomheder bistår vi store private virksomheder og offentlige organisationer med deres digitale omstilling.

Vi lægger vægt på at skabe værdi for vores kunder og samfundet og har som mål at skabe en bedre og mere bæredygtig fremtid.

Teradyne is a leading supplier of Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) used to test complex electronics in the consumer electronics, automotive, computing, telecommunications, aerospace, and defense industries. In 2023, Teradyne generated $2.7 billion in revenue and employed approximately 6,500 people worldwide.

The Semiconductor Test Division is the world's largest supplier of semiconductor test equipment for logic, RF, analog, power, mixed-signal, and memory technologies. The Nextest division is responsible for the Magnum family of memory test products.

For more information, visit www.teradyne.com .

At Teradyne, experience meets innovation as we drive excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity, diversity of thought, and the strength of our workforce. Our employees are driven to innovate and learn something new every day.

Understand customer requirements and find innovative ways to incorporate them into our existing software architecture.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to cross-functional teams.

new_jobs.description:
What The Role Is

The Future of Finance Institute (FFI) is being established as an industry platform that brings together financial institutions, FinTechs, technology firms and research partners to support the adoption of emerging technologies across Singapore's financial sector. FFI's work spans areas such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), digital assets and next-generation financial infrastructure. It aims to help industry participants translate technological advances into practical capabilities, strengthen implementation pathways and support the long-term development of Singapore's financial ecosystem.

What You Will Be Working On

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) to help build the digital capabilities that support FFI's mission. You will work closely with financial institutions, technology firms and research partners to design and develop platforms, services and tools that support the application of new technologies to real business and operational challenges. Your work will help industry participants develop new capabilities, learn from implementation experience and deploy solutions more effectively.

This is an opportunity to join a newly established organisation, shape technology solutions from an early stage, and contribute to challenges that extend beyond any single institution or company. You will work at the intersection of technology, finance and industry development, helping to strengthen Singapore's position as a leading global financial centre.

What You'll Do:

Design, develop and maintain full-stack applications that support FFI's programmes and industry initiatives
Build digital platforms, services and APIs that help financial institutions develop and deploy new technological capabilities
Develop digital capabilities that support industry capability development, implementation pathways and the application of new technologies across financial services
Design and implement secure backend services, data platforms and system integrations
Work across frontend, backend, cloud and data environments to deliver reliable, secure and maintainable software solutions
Work directly with financial institutions, technology firms and researchers to understand industry challenges and translate them into practical technology solutions
Help shape the technical architecture, engineering practices and technology choices that underpin FFI's digital capabilities
Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and software engineering best practices
Conduct code reviews, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve system performance, security and reliability
Support the ongoing enhancement of platforms and services based on user feedback and evolving industry needs

What We Are Looking For

Minimum 5 years of full-stack development experience with ability to work independently whilst collaborating effectively in cross-functional teams
Proficiency in Angular and React frameworks for frontend development of financial technology applications
Experience with popular backend frameworks such as Node.js (Express), Python (Django/Flask), Java (Spring Boot), or .NET Core
Hands-on experience with RDBMS (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB), and caching systems (e.g., Redis)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Docker, container orchestration, and microservices architecture
Previous experience in financial services, banking, insurance, or FinTech sectors
Proven track record developing secure, internet-facing applications with user authentication systems
Strong understanding of secure coding practices for regulated financial environments
Experience with CI/CD processes, SQL optimisation, and database design for high-performance applications
Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, and performance optimisation techniques

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
Familiarity with vector database technologies and AI/ML infrastructure
Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration in enterprise environments
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation
Experience working on AI implementation projects or digital transformation initiatives within financial institutions
Experience in payments, capital markets, insurance or banking sectors
Experience working in multicultural, international business environments

Personal Attributes:

Ability to work independently whilst collaborating effectively in cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholder relationships
Critical thinking skills and results-oriented mindset with focus on delivering high-quality outputs that drive meaningful impact for Singapore's financial sector
Adaptability to work in a fast-paced, evolving regulatory environment with changing priorities and emerging technologies
Intellectual curiosity and commitment to continuous learning in rapidly evolving AI and financial technology landscapes
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments.

This is a 1-year contract. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

new_jobs.description:
Summary

The Senior Engineer will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge technology solutions to drive business growth and efficiency within the organization. This position requires a strategic thinker who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to identify and address complex technical challenges. The ideal candidate should possess deep expertise in software development, system integration, cloud technologies, and data analytics, along with strong abilities to works towards innovative problem-solving.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Solution Architecture & Design: Lead the architectural design of scalable, secure, and high-performance technology systems, integrating best practices for resilience, performance, and cost management.
Project Development & Delivery: Oversee project delivery, managing timelines, resources, and budgets while ensuring adherence to quality standards.
Collaboration & Communication: Foster effective collaboration among teams, vendors, partners, and stakeholders through clear communication of project plans, progress updates, and key decisions.
Innovation & Research: Stay updated on emerging technologies and assess their potential impact on business operations. Drive innovation by piloting new ideas, tools, and methodologies to enhance operational efficiency and competitive advantage.
Risk Mitigation & Compliance: Ensure compliance with industry regulations and internal policies related to information security, data privacy, and intellectual property protection. Proactively manage risks associated with technology implementation and operation.
Cost Optimization: Implement efficient resource allocation strategies to optimize costs for IT solutions
Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Establish metrics and reporting mechanisms to evaluate IT performance against strategic objectives, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as needed.
Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity: Develop comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plans to minimize service interruptions and ensure seamless operations during unexpected events or crises.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred.
7 years of software engineering experience, ideally within the aviation or travel industry.
Deep understanding of enterprise architecture principles, cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure), DevOps practices, and agile development methodologies.
Strong knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, solution design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance processes.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide IT professionals towards achieving common goals.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects, while also being a team player who actively contributes to group efforts.
High level of integrity, confidentiality, and trustworthiness when handling sensitive information.
Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines.
Knowledge of OutSystems is a plus
